hf.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
hf.abstract: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.
hf.titleZh: Sage S2.1 Flash 技术报告
hf.summaryZh: 320B 参数的通用 MoE 模型，目标是在科学证据上推理并在交互式环境中执行动作:分子图与生物序列由专用编码器处理，谱数据表示为有序的测量 patch，再经模态专属 projector 映射进共享骨干，与文本、图像一同处理。Agent 能力依托可验证环境构建，覆盖工具调用、搜索、编码，以及机器学习实验与科学软件等专用工作流，任务完成以执行结果、环境状态变化或提交产物判定。在 7 个领域 33 个 benchmark 上，OfficeQA Pro(72.2)、MLE-bench Lite(90.3 HumanRank)、Harvey LAB、SpreadsheetBench 2 排名第一，OSWorld-Verified(85.2)、WebArena-Verified(67.6)、DeepResearch Bench II(54.2)排名第二;优势集中在文档证据使用、可验证表格产出与机器学习任务执行，桌面与浏览器视觉反馈操作亦具竞争力。
hf.reason: 旗舰级 MoE 技术报告，Agent 环境与科学推理并重，直接命中高分方向

hf.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
hf.abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
hf.titleZh: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的 AI 基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 医疗 AI 的评测覆盖在不同医疗角色、任务与照护场景之间分布不均。InclusionMed 以 Atlas 组织基准，按三种医疗角色与三种 AI 能力交叉成九个格子，首版从 388 个候选基准中经结构化审计与独立复现选出四个公开基准，并加入私有的诊断推理基准 DxFiles，共覆盖九个格子中的三个。评测前沿 LLM 后汇总为 InclusionMed Index，总分区间仅 17.5–49.1（满分 100），模型排名随角色与能力变化，排名前十的模型在患者沟通上均优于临床决策，且 Index 分数相近的模型推理成本差异显著。
hf.reason: 医疗领域基准，仅评测方法学与 LLM 评估稍沾边

hf.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
hf.abstract: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at https://ifm.ai/k2/
hf.titleZh: K2-Horizon:一支前沿的开源语言模型舰队
hf.summaryZh: 覆盖 0.9B 稠密到 375B-A23B MoE 的六个完全开源模型，面向数学、科学、软件工程、深度研究与办公自动化等通用推理与 Agent 任务，在智能体与代码基准上领先或可比同规模强开源模型。方法上提出 Mixture-of-Value Attention(对注意力 value 投影施加 MoE)与 softplus 注意力门控，36B-A4B 以约七分之一激活参数接近同数据训练的 32B 稠密模型;Uno 无损扩散适配器无需草稿模型即把解码加速至多 2.2x。发布遵循 LLM360 开源定义，开放各阶段 checkpoint、约 10T 合成 token、训练日志与 xLLM、RL360 栈，四个模型共享 22T token 语料以受控研究规模与稀疏度。
hf.reason: 旗舰开源模型家族技术报告，含注意力新机制与全流程开放

hf.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
hf.abstract: Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives. We present AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories. To capture dependencies among portfolio positions, AllocFlow employs a cross-asset flow Transformer conditioned on temporal market representations to generate continuous, signed position weights across all instruments jointly. To address the sample inefficiency and instability of learning continuous allocation policies from scratch, we establish a two-stage training scheme: strategy-supervised imitation shapes a structured distribution of candidate portfolios, followed by group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) that refines joint decisions using portfolio-level financial rewards and a frozen policy reference. On hourly cryptocurrency perpetual futures, RL refinement raises the annualized net return of the imitation policy from 27.79% to 51.38% and its Calmar ratio from 0.955 to 4.043, surpassing the teacher strategy on every metric, and AllocFlow reaches a Calmar ratio of 4.90 on six further months of unseen 2026 data without retraining.
hf.titleZh: AllocFlow：从原始市场数据端到端生成组合交易动作
hf.summaryZh: 传统量化流程把信号预测与组合构建分开，导致学习目标与配置、执行目标不一致。AllocFlow 用端到端 flow matching 直接从原始多资产历史生成联合持仓，跨资产 flow Transformer 以时序市场表示为条件，一次性输出所有标的的连续带符号权重。训练分两阶段：先用策略监督模仿塑造候选组合分布，再用组相对强化学习（GRPO 类）结合组合级金融奖励与冻结策略参考做精修。在小时级加密货币永续合约上，RL 精修把年化净收益从 27.79% 提升到 51.38%，Calmar 比率由 0.955 升至 4.043，超过教师策略；在未见过的 2026 年六个月数据上不做重训仍达 4.90。
hf.reason: 金融组合交易垂直应用，仅组相对 RL 与后训练略沾边

hf.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
hf.abstract: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each assignment places an agent in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues who have distinct responsibilities, bounded knowledge, and controlled collaboration behavior. Starting from a brief handoff, agents must recover requirements distributed across colleagues and workplace records, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes evaluated by private executable tests. We evaluate eleven models and find a substantial gap between partial implementation and complete task delivery. The two leading models satisfy approximately 63% of fail-to-pass (F2P) tests but complete fewer than 8% of assignments. Providing complete requirements upfront improves F2P by approximately 16 percentage points for Seed Evolving and GPT-6 Astra, yet leaves complete task success unchanged. Requirement-level trajectory analysis reveals failures throughout the delivery process: Claude-Opus-5.5 directs a mean of 93% of first questions about queried cards to their accountable owners across runs but obtains only 64% of colleague-held requirements. Deferred questions go unfollowed, implementations remain incomplete even after requirements are acquired, and 31% of requirements reported as completed fail their tests. These findings highlight sustained requirement tracking, from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, as a key challenge for reliable autonomous software engineering.
hf.titleZh: SWE-CoWork:将编程智能体作为组织中的数字员工进行评测
hf.summaryZh: 评测编程智能体在软件组织内部独立完成开发任务的能力:智能体需先弄清要做什么、与同事协作、再验证交付物。SWE-CoWork 构建了 101 个开发任务，覆盖 101 个真实仓库、11 种编程语言与 12 个应用领域，每个任务将智能体置于含 26 名同事的模拟工程组织中，这些同事职责不同、知识边界受限、协作行为受控;智能体需从交接简报出发，向同事与工作记录追索分散的需求、消解冲突证据，并通过私有可执行测试验收。评测 11 个模型后发现:两个最强模型可满足约 63% 的 fail-to-pass(F2P)测试，但完整完成任务的比例不足 8%;提前给出完整需求可使 F2P 提升约 16 个百分点，但完整成功率毫无变化。轨迹分析显示失败贯穿交付全程:首轮提问有 93% 指向正确责任人，却只拿到 64% 的同事侧需求，被推迟的问题无人跟进，需求到手后实现仍不完整，31% 自报完成的需求未通过测试。
hf.reason: Agent 与代码智能体评测基准，组织级需求追踪，紧贴关注方向

hf.title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
hf.abstract: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tools' typed returns: an email's sender or a payment's account arrives in a typed field, while injected instructions arrive as free text. SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan. The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule. A deterministic sanitizer removes instruction-like regions its fixed rules match before the model reads them and retains the removed spans as evidence, and a local judge may restore a refused call, never one whose target lies in the removed text. Across three backbones, and seven task suites on one of them, no standard templated injection redirects an action to an attacker's target under SPILLWAY, at the highest observed mean utility and composite scores (NRP, ERS) of the defenses we run under that attack. A forged chat template also produces a raw zero, and mean in-scope attack success under a released reinforcement-learning attacker is .007. SPILLWAY reaches this floor with no defense-triggered backbone re-run and almost no added model call. As personal AI agents act on users' email, files, and payments, SPILLWAY gives them an auditable refusal floor on where their actions go that keeps them useful and holds across backbones.
hf.titleZh: SPILLWAY：把目标准入与净化分离，防御工具使用型智能体的提示注入
hf.summaryZh: 工具使用型智能体操作邮件、文件与支付，网页或文档中隐藏的指令即可诱导其把数据或钱转给攻击者；现有运行时防御要么让模型参与放行决策、读取攻击者文本并增加每步模型调用，要么需模型先规划路由。SPILLWAY改从工具返回数据的类型来判定一个动作的目标：仅当新出现的目标值来自只读工具的类型化字段或被固定委派规则覆盖时才放行；确定性净化器在模型读取前删除指令式片段，本地裁判可恢复被拒调用，但不能恢复目标落在删除文本中的调用。在三个骨干模型上，标准模板化注入无一重定向成功；在同类防御中，NRP/ERS综合分居首位；在已发布的强化学习攻击者下，攻击成功率降至0.007。
hf.reason: Agent提示注入的确定性防御，多骨干实验扎实，直接命中Agent安全方向

hf.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
hf.abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.
hf.titleZh: ScaleVLA:将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展到5520亿参数
hf.summaryZh: 考察前沿规模的视觉语言模型能否作为机器人策略的表征基础:把552B的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash骨干接到可训练的动作DiT上，在统一训练配置下系统对比2B至552B的VLM。样本效率上仅10条示范即超过2B骨干用50条示范的表现(87.8%对85.6%);LIBERO-PRO成功率达45.1%，小骨干至多31.3%;真机充电器插入从4/10提升到9/10，增益集中在接触敏感的对齐环节。单动作块中位延迟216ms，表明前沿VLM不仅可作推理智能体，也能为高效、可泛化的机器人策略提供表征底座。
hf.reason: 552B级VLA规模化系统对比，直接命中旗舰具身基础模型方向

hf.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
hf.abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).
hf.titleZh: PaperCritic：训练 AI 审稿人以评估论文的严谨性
hf.summaryZh: 针对 AI 审稿简单模仿人类评审的问题，将评审目标收窄到最客观的「严谨性」维度，把学习目标定义为评审意见精确率（意见扎实有据）与召回率（覆盖高质量参考意见）的联合最大化。基于 1K 篇 ICLR 投稿构建含 23K 条人工与 LLM 评审意见的质量标注数据集 PaperSound-23K，并以精确率与召回率的 F1 为奖励，用强化学习训练审稿模型 PaperCritic。在域内测试集上优于前沿模型与其他 AI 审稿训练方法，且训练所得能力可迁移到 Nature 系列论文评审，以及代码审查、法律合同审查、故事写作反馈等域外任务。
hf.reason: AI 审稿的 RL 训练与评测方法学，含数据集与迁移实验

hf.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
hf.abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
hf.titleZh: LynnReal-Hand：用手部控制解锁世界交互
hf.summaryZh: 针对文本与相机控制难以直接操纵物体的局限，以手部动作作为交互接口，构建手控视频世界模型。工作整理10万段真实与合成交互片段并设计手部感知监督，学习因果流映射实现少步生成，提出区域感知得分蒸馏融合视频与图像先验，并用紧凑的Ultra-Fast-VAE降低解码开销。在HandBench上，完整序列模型取得FVD 181.67、MANO Dice 93.02，三步因果模型保持92.49；单张H200上540p流式生成达18.03 FPS、741ms延迟、峰值显存34.89GB。
hf.reason: 手控视频世界模型属视觉生成方向，与LLM后训练/Agent关注点无交集

hf.title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
hf.abstract: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.
hf.titleZh: Accelerate Bench：评估应用级程序优化的智能体
hf.summaryZh: 针对应用级（而非单个函数）程序优化构建评测：32 个改编自科学计算与超算竞赛的 CPU 任务，每项给出可运行程序、工作负载、正确性要求、时间边界与允许改动范围，由智能体自行决定优化何处与如何优化，公开测试支持迭代，最终由独立 verifier 打分。v1.1 上评测 16 个「模型 + harness」组合的编程智能体，Score@1 介于 25.5% 到 67.4%，多数程序正确，差距主要在加速比：前两名在 22 个以上任务达到 2x 及以上，其余十四个仅在 8 到 17 个任务达标，其 412 个正确结果中有 125 个低于 1.25x。控制重放显示同一份源码因构建与运行配置不同可跑出 0.29x 到 2.12x，某处改动的收益随另一处改动在 1.01x 与 6.4x 之间变化，说明跨整个程序的协调才是难点。基准同时公开可执行负载与智能体的程序和轨迹，兼顾收益与优化过程评估。
hf.reason: 编程智能体＋程序优化基准，命中代码智能与 Agent 评测方向

hf.title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
hf.abstract: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose VoxMel, a tokenizer-free framework for autoregressive TTS that makes stable mel modeling tractable through a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. The transform first decomposes each mel spectrogram along frequency into local averages and a frequency residual, then splits the averaged component along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual. A language-model backbone with a flow-matching head autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel. Non-autoregressive residual tiers then predict the temporal residual from Coarse-Mel, followed by the frequency residual conditioned on the reconstructed Frequency-Averaged Mel. Neither residual is fed back into the autoregressive history. Trained on 100K hours of Emilia, the supervised 0.6B model obtains 1.51\% WER and 0.738 speaker similarity (SIM) on test-en, and 1.29\% CER and 0.755 SIM on test-zh. GRPO improves these results to 1.15\% WER / 0.753 SIM and 1.17\% CER / 0.776 SIM, respectively. We also distill the guided flow head into two- and four-step students, requiring 2 or 4 head evaluations per coarse frame. The four-step student retains competitive SIM and nearly matches the supervised model in WER/CER.
hf.titleZh: VoxMel TTS 技术报告

hf.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
hf.abstract: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
hf.titleZh: MovieRoll：面向长视频生成的系统性落地框架
hf.summaryZh: 针对流式视频生成在超出训练时长后质量衰减、自生成历史漂移与KV缓存持续膨胀的问题，提出由基座训练到蒸馏的两段式框架。先用窗口化教师强制（WinTF）结合窗口内双向注意力与因果历史访问建立多步基座，并用分层KV缓存压缩（HieraKV）在浅层保留全历史、深层仅保留sink与近端历史，缓存降低最多78%且质量提升；再用累积长程调优与分布匹配蒸馏（CuLT-DMD）实现少步生成器的高效长rollout训练，配合KV重计算与引导退火（AnnealCFG）把生成延伸到训练时长之外。在HeliosBench上，仅在不超过15秒视频上训练的基座在30秒处仍具竞争力，蒸馏版在长达60秒的单事件与多事件评测中总分最高，兼顾自然度与运动活跃度。

hf.title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
hf.abstract: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.
hf.titleZh: SALA:语义对齐的潜在动作实现具身基础模型的双轴扩展
hf.summaryZh: 现有潜在动作模型主要靠视频重建学习表示，容易按视觉外观而非动作本质聚类，导致人类动作难以对齐到机器人动作。SALA在不需配对数据的条件下，利用人类与机器人视频片段的语言描述估计语义相似度，将其转化为软邻域结构，引导人类潜在动作向语义相关的机器人潜在动作靠拢，同时以机器人动作重建把潜在空间锚定在控制上。由此得到的共享潜在动作空间为在人类视频与机器人视频上联合训练具身基础模型提供统一监督，并支持双轴扩展:预训练数据量增加持续降低下游机器人动作预测误差，任务相关人类视频后训练数据量增加显著提升真机任务成功率。该方法为跨本体数据利用与具身基础模型的规模化训练提供了新路径。
hf.reason: VLA/具身基础模型的跨本体潜在动作对齐与双轴扩展，正中高分方向

hf.title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
hf.abstract: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.
hf.titleZh: Calpha:迈向通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
hf.summaryZh: 把蛋白质折叠能力并入通用 LLM:Qwen3.5-9B 读取带 ESM2 残基特征的序列，可文本作答，也可发出 token 调用预训练 SimpleFold 结构头，结构头仅经由 Qwen 的残基状态获知蛋白信息。在固定折叠请求下，该结构头在 FoldBench-334 上平均 TM-score 0.808,CASP16 结构域 0.635,CAMEO 风格 PDB 集 0.900;与 ESM2-3B 编码加微调 SimpleFold-3B 的基线相比，100–299 残基三条配对置信区间均含零，300–600 残基平均差为 -0.044、-0.160、-0.025。蛋白训练使 MMLU-Pro 350 题子集从 77.4% 降至 70.3%，复合物预测、结构理解与语言推理对坐标的影响仍待后续工作。

hf.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
hf.abstract: Looping is a powerful inductive bias for reasoning. By repeatedly iterating a recurrent block, looped models can scale their effective depth and enable multi-step reasoning in latent space. However, existing looped models are not inherently guided by an explicit measure of progress, making it difficult to determine when to stop looping and how to improve upon the current state. To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. The energy scores latent states, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a signal for stopping. To train EBRs effectively, we further introduce exploration-based training to discover additional modes and to better shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or outperform prior recurrent reasoning models, achieving 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345times less inference compute than the next-best model and maintaining comparable training compute. On all multi-solution benchmarks, EBRs achieve state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions while maintaining near-100% single-sample accuracy. These results suggest that energy-based models are a promising approach for strong reasoning performance.
hf.titleZh: 基于能量的推理器:你的循环推理器应当是一个能量模型
hf.summaryZh: 循环迭代是增强推理能力的有效归纳偏置，但现有looped模型缺少显式的进度度量，难以判断何时停止循环、如何改进当前隐状态。EBR在隐推理状态上学习能量函数，把循环更新表述为对该能量的梯度下降:能量值负责给状态打分，梯度引导状态精修并提供停止信号;配合exploration-based训练以发现更多模式，并在更广的状态集上塑造能量景观。在四个算法推理基准上匹配或超过已有循环推理模型，Sudoku-Extreme上达到99.9%准确率，推理算力比次优模型少345倍而训练算力相当;多解基准上取得最优的合法解覆盖度，同时保持近100%的单样本准确率。
hf.reason: 循环推理与能量模型结合，方法新颖且Sudoku结果突出

hf.title: Correcting Persistent Failures in Point-Cloud Grasping Policies using Human Demonstrations in Virtual Reality
hf.abstract: Robots in homes, warehouses and farms must pick up objects they have never seen, usually without a 3D model or a category label. A grasping policy that works directly on the point cloud from a depth sensor needs only the geometry the robot observes, so it applies to any new object. Offline grasp generators such as Contact-GraspNet work this way, but they rank grasps by learned plausibility rather than by whether the grasp actually lifts the object. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize for that directly and make a point-cloud grasping policy much better on average, yet it leaves specific grasps persistently unsolved. We present a human-in-the-loop failure loop that targets those grasps: situations an RL policy keeps failing are mined automatically, sent to a virtual-reality application where a person picks the object up with their own hands, and returned to training as two grasp points. The person contributes only where to grasp; the robot chooses its own approach. In simulation, RL raises success on unseen objects from 55% with Contact-GraspNet to 83%. Adding 58 human demonstrations nearly doubles success on the hard cases RL kept failing, from 24% to 45%, and recovers performance that RL alone loses on similar cases that were never demonstrated, without reducing success on unseen objects.
hf.titleZh: 用虚拟现实中的人类示范纠正点云抓取策略中的持续性失败
hf.summaryZh: 针对点云抓取策略在强化学习后仍反复失败的特定抓取，系统自动挖掘这些持续失败情形，交由人在VR中用双手完成抓取，并以两个抓取点的形式回灌训练，人只决定抓哪里、机器人自行选择接近方式。仿真中RL把未见物体成功率从Contact-GraspNet的55%提升到83%，加入58条人类示范后，难例成功率从24%升至45%，并在未示范的相似情形上恢复RL单独训练所损失的性能，且不降低未见物体成功率。该方法将稀缺人类干预精准投放到策略盲区，适用于家居、仓储等无模型未知物体的抓取场景。

hf.title: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
hf.abstract: Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model's own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). Layer-12 speaker readouts detect speaker change with AUROC 0.966-0.980 on AMI and VoxConverse, above an ECAPA baseline, and count speakers (0, 1, 2, or 3+) more accurately than pyannote 3.1. The turn-end readout reaches AUROC 0.930 versus Smart Turn v3.2 at 0.982 on Smart Turn's own test set. On a subset of ICSI meetings labeled by next speaker, AUROC is 0.716 versus 0.712; the paired confidence interval includes zero.
hf.titleZh: Marimba：一个面向语音的系统一模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向语音应用中词项是否出现、话轮是否结束、语种判断等决策，在冻结的 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 特征之上构建统一的类型化语音判定接口：词法问题用 ASR 转写的零样本打分，非词法问题用问题条件化头与第 18 层话轮结束读出，语种识别复用 ASR 自身的语言分数。私有对话测试集上解码器 AUROC 为 0.80–0.92，公开朗读语音为 0.92–0.97，Speech Commands 四分类 0.93，二元词法 ECE 不超过 0.08；说话人变化检测在 AMI 与 VoxConverse 上 AUROC 为 0.966–0.980，优于 ECAPA 基线。话轮结束读出 AUROC 0.930，低于 Smart Turn v3.2 的 0.982。可作为一种共享冻结 ASR 特征的轻量多任务语音前端方案。

hf.title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
hf.abstract: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize termination lag--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.
hf.titleZh: 终止滞后：编程智能体早已解出，却迟迟不停
hf.summaryZh: 编程智能体常常在已经解出任务后仍继续工作，形成从首次正确补丁到运行结束之间的额外步数，即终止滞后。研究记录并逐一测试执行过程中产生的每个仓库补丁，在五个模型、两个智能体框架和三个 SWE-bench 数据集上量化该现象：38–82% 的成功运行在第一次源码编辑时即已得到正确解，但 Qwen3-Coder 与 Laguna-XS.2 的成功运行中，解后步数中位数分别占 35–37% 与 54–60%，主要用于自我验证与仓库探索；另有 1–8% 的运行因后续改动撤销了原本正确的补丁，最终反而失败。这揭示了智能体停止判据的系统性缺陷，对 Agent 的早停、验证开销控制与 harness 设计有直接价值。
hf.reason: 编程智能体停止行为实证分析，命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

hf.title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
hf.abstract: Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.
hf.titleZh: DominoBench：从静态图像评估多步物理推理
hf.summaryZh: 从静态图像预测刚体场景的连锁反应：构建 DominoBench，含 854 题、427 组最小对照对——单个量改动 1–3 格即决定人物是否存活，每题附四级提示阶梯直至决定性计算，标准答案由物理模拟器给出。测试 10 个家族 30 个模型，无辅助时前沿模型在命运翻转者身份上至多 72% 正确，同一对照对两题全对至多 34%；提示关键步骤或给出精确几何文本帮助有限，而写出决定性计算及其所需量（含静态图无法显示的速度）后升至 82–92%，小开源模型仍近随机。表明 VLM 的物理预测失败在定量环节：给定决定性量会用，却无法自主产出。
hf.reason: VLM 物理推理 benchmark，偏多模态评测，与 Agent 方向仅弱相关

hf.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
hf.abstract: When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tasks agree. To go beyond our grid, we fit one scaling law to both models, in which latent feedback enters as a Transformer with more parameters; it predicts that both savings keep growing with unique data and repetition. Fitted on models from 60M to 271M parameters, the law predicts the losses at a held-out 778M size to within 0.3% and the gap between the two models to within 0.05%. At most, latent feedback saves 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data. When data, not compute, is the limit, latent feedback is the better use of a FLOP for a model of a given size.
hf.titleZh: Latent Feedback 是算力与数据的放大器
hf.summaryZh: 高质量数据耗尽后重复训练同一批数据的收益逐轮递减；latent feedback 把每个 token 的顶层状态回灌到下一个 token 的输入，此前尚未与同等算力下多跑几轮 epoch 的 Transformer 做过对照。研究在模型规模、唯一数据量与 epoch 数构成的网格上逐点调参对比，并用统一 scaling law 拟合两类模型，其中 latent feedback 等价于参数更多的 Transformer。拟合自 60M–271M 模型，对留出的 778M 规模 loss 预测误差在 0.3% 以内、两模型差距误差 0.05%；最多可省 48% 算力与 47% 唯一数据，节省幅度随每参数数据量与重复次数增长。当数据而非算力成为瓶颈时，latent feedback 是给定规模模型下更划算的 FLOP 用法。
hf.reason: 新架构机制加 scaling law 分析，直接命中预训练方向

hf.title: Abstention Direction in Large Language Models: Mechanistic Interpretability of Abstention Across Query Ambiguity, Knowledge Limits, and Safety Alignment
hf.abstract: Abstention, the withholding of a response by a large language model (LLM) under uncertainty or safety risks, is essential for trustworthy models. The causes of abstention fall into three perspectives: ambiguity in the Query (Q), limits of Model Knowledge (MK), and misalignment with Human Values (HV). However, prior analyses of internal representations have focused on HV, using a refusal direction computed from harmful and harmless queries. No study has analyzed the three perspectives jointly. We therefore extend the refusal direction framework to all three perspectives. Specifically, for each perspective, we construct counterfactual pairs that share a template and differ only in the abstention-inducing factor, and compute an abstention direction by normalizing the difference in mean activations between the two polarities. Activation steering experiments show that intervening in middle layers increases or decreases abstention across all three perspectives. Moreover, steering yields cross-perspective effects, indicating that the abstention directions share a common directional component.
hf.titleZh: 大语言模型中的弃答方向:跨查询歧义、知识边界与安全对齐的弃答机制可解释性
hf.summaryZh: 将「拒绝方向」框架从安全对齐扩展到弃答的三种成因:查询歧义、模型知识边界与人类价值错位。针对每种视角构造模板相同、仅弃答诱发因素不同的反事实配对，以两极激活均值之差归一化得到弃答方向。激活引导实验显示，干预中间层可双向调节三种视角下的弃答行为，且引导存在跨视角效应，说明三者的弃答方向共享共同的方向分量。该工作为理解与调控LLM的不确定性表达提供了统一的机制性视角。
hf.reason: 弃答方向的机制性分析与激活引导，对齐与可解释性方向的扎实工作

hf.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
hf.abstract: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. Experiments with seven frontier LLMs show that several agents underperform a simple rule-based baseline, while only the leading agent consistently surpasses it. Trajectory analysis shows that some agents apply known constraints inconsistently and make new decisions that conflict with existing commitments. Agents with more reliable fulfillment can still secure low returns from comparable commitments or delay resource reallocation. The leading agent better connects preparation with economic choices but also misses opportunities for more profitable asset use. These findings highlight limitations in sustaining coherent resource plans and reassessing their value over time. The benchmark code is publicly available at https://github.com/adminblackjack/OutfitterBench.
hf.titleZh: OutfitterBench：评估 LLM Agent 的长程资源分配与承诺协调能力
hf.summaryZh: 长程任务中，Agent 自身的决策会制造未来约束：承诺占用有限资源即形成后续义务，并排除其他机会，因此需要在计划保持可行的同时权衡资源分配与被替代方案的价值。为此构建 OutfitterBench：Agent 在固定资金上限下经营 200 天的户外装备租赁业务，从 46 种商品目录采购，处理约 1100 条预订请求，并应对可复用装备上确定预订与不确定到店需求的竞争。七个前沿 LLM 的实验中，多个 Agent 低于简单规则基线，仅最优者稳定超越；轨迹分析显示部分 Agent 对已知约束应用不一致、新决策与既有承诺冲突，履约较可靠者也可能承诺回报偏低或延迟资源再分配。
hf.reason: Agent 长程资源规划 benchmark，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax
hf.abstract: Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). Furthermore, to make this competence reusable towards new goals, we factor the previous controller into an environment interpreter I (models, memory, skills) and a rule program p_0, and we show that coding agents can optimize a reusable goal compiler C_θ that maps structured tasks g into new rule programs p_g. Across five independent compiler searches trained only on short tasks, the resulting compilers successfully transfer zero-shot to longer tasks without any task-specific tuning nor inference-time LLM calls: continuation-scored feedback and a fixed machine with an editable program together turn a single-task competent policy into a reusable one. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/craftax-program-policies
hf.titleZh: Craftax 中延续引导的 LLM 程序策略与目标编译器进化
hf.summaryZh: 针对长程任务中编码智能体合成的程序策略易受局部改进拖累、切换目标需重新昂贵合成的问题，提出反馈级联：从回合回报逐级细化到分层目标与信念更新，利用模拟器稠密评分进化程序策略。在部分可观测且程序生成的 Craftax 中，仅用回合级反馈到达最终关卡的比例不足 1%，级联反馈把该比例提升至 50%（最终 Boss 击败率 28%）。进一步将控制器分解为环境解释器与规则程序，让编码智能体优化可复用目标编译器，将结构化任务映射为新规则程序；仅在短任务上搜索的五个编译器可零样本迁移到更长任务，无需任务特定调优或推理时 LLM 调用。
hf.reason: 编码智能体进化程序策略并零样本迁移，命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

hf.title: Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos
hf.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how human egocentric videos can benefit robot policy learning without action supervision. Building on a pretrained VLM, we propose Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR), an MoT architecture in which future visual state prediction can provide independent and complementary learning signals alongside action prediction. We find that representations learned from egocentric videos improve downstream performance on out-of-distribution robot tasks, with further gains as video data scales. We also study the effects of objective choices and data curation, providing insights into how to leverage action-free videos for scalable robot learning.
hf.titleZh: Ego Guidance：用无动作的第一视角人类视频增强机器人策略学习
hf.summaryZh: 研究如何在没有动作监督的情况下，利用人类第一视角视频来提升机器人策略学习:在预训练VLM之上提出SPAR，一种基于MoT的架构，让未来视觉状态预测与动作预测共享主干，作为独立且互补的学习信号并行训练。实验显示，从第一视角视频学到的表征能提升分布外机器人任务的表现，并且随着视频数据规模扩大，收益继续增长;论文还系统分析了目标函数选择与数据筛选的影响，给出了如何利用无动作视频做可扩展机器人学习的经验。
hf.reason: 第一视角视频到机器人策略，属数据规模化擦边方向，摘要无量化结果

hf.title: Correct Labels Are Not Enough: Reliable Metadata Can Silently Control Model Behavior
hf.abstract: Fine-tuning data can include metadata that predicts the correct answer, such as a reward-model score or a quality label. We ask whether a model learns to rely on this metadata even when every training label is correct. We fine-tune 7-9B open-weight models from three families on multiple-choice questions in which (Reward: 5) always marks the correct option; when this annotation is moved to a wrong option at test time, models select that option on 97-100% of CommonsenseQA items. Removing it leaves most answers correct, so evaluation without it misses the dependence. Cue-following rises sharply with training-time reliability and develops even with neutral or nonsense annotation words, although test-time wording affects its strength. A Qwen3 experiment also finds cue dependence in option-letter scores after direct preference optimization. Audits can test for this dependence by moving or removing visible annotations while holding the task and correct answer fixed.
hf.titleZh: 标签正确还不够:可靠元数据可悄然操控模型行为
hf.summaryZh: 微调数据里的元数据(如reward-model分数、质量标签)往往能预测正确答案，即使所有训练标签都正确，模型也可能学会依赖它。研究者在三个模型家族的7–9B开放权重模型上用多选题微调，使(Reward: 5)始终标在正确选项上;测试时把该标注移到错误选项，模型在CommonsenseQA上有97–100%的题目选中该错误项。移除标注后多数答案仍正确，说明常规评测会漏掉这种依赖;线索跟随强度随训练期标注可靠性上升，中性或无意义词也能诱发，Qwen3上DPO后的选项字母分数同样出现依赖。据此提出固定任务与正确答案、仅移动或移除可见标注的审计流程。
hf.reason: 揭示微调元数据引发的隐性线索依赖，评测方法学扎实

hf.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
hf.abstract: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.
hf.titleZh: 更多智能体、更多采样，还是更多思考?厘清多智能体 LLM 中的协调、集成与测试时计算
hf.summaryZh: 多智能体 LLM 的评测常把通信架构与单次贪心解码对比，混淆了协调机制、样本数量与推理算力三项因素。该工作整合九项实证评估、516 个多智能体配置，按六维资源向量与四级基线阶梯统一组织，并用多层随机效应模型在 log odds 尺度检验差异。在与样本数或资源预算匹配的基线对比中，多智能体平均准确率为 -0.042,74% 的对比不高于基线;基线由贪心换为采样时差异平均再降 0.038。结论是智能体共享同一证据时通信不带来新信息，正收益需依赖证据划分、外部验证或模型间误差多样性，并附审稿清单与算力核算工具。
hf.reason: 多智能体评测方法学的系统元分析，直击 Agent 评测混淆因素

hf.title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
hf.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.
hf.titleZh: JEPA4R：面向具身智能的4D点规划JEPA世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 针对JEPA世界模型依赖2D图像导致操作所需的度量几何隐式且与外观纠缠、想象内容不可见且多在短时程潜空间规划中评估的问题，提出直接观察单深度相机点云并在其潜空间预测与规划的4D点规划方法，在冻结世界模型潜空间上接策略头执行动作，并用解码器将想象可视化为4D点云，200步平均点误差不超过1.1 cm。在OGBench的Cube-Single、Cube-Double、Cube-Triple和Scene上领先像素JEPA模型，在MetaWorld与Adroit Relocate上分别取得98.4%和88.0%，高于第二名R3M的96.0%和65.3%。仅在数字孪生中训练后，JEPA4R及策略头可零样本迁移到真实机械臂，兼容夹爪与灵巧手。
hf.reason: 具身JEPA世界模型与4D点规划，方法新且有真机零样本，命中世界模型方向

hf.title: UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models
hf.abstract: Unified multimodal models can support both visual understanding and generation, yet generative training does not necessarily improve understanding. We argue that this limitation may arise from a mismatch between the representation targeted by generation and the perceptual representation used for understanding. Conventional generation objectives primarily optimize synthesis-oriented spaces such as discrete visual codes or generative latents. We therefore introduce UMM-JEPA, which reformulates generation as progressive prediction of continuous visual-understanding representations. The model constructs a multi-scale representation hierarchy from coarse to fine, while pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward. Controlled comparisons show that the representation-prediction objective accounts for most of the understanding improvement, while a data-matched control leaves the group means nearly unchanged. UMM-JEPA reaches a 16-benchmark visual mean of 51.71, against 46.36 for the understanding-only Qwen-VL baseline, and the text mean also rises. Compared with discrete-code and latent-flow generation objectives, perceptual representation prediction yields stronger and more consistent transfer to understanding. Linear probes and visual-evidence interventions further reveal richer object and spatial structure and stronger use of image-specific information. These results suggest that generation can benefit understanding when it directly supervises the perceptual representations that understanding consumes.
hf.titleZh: UMM-JEPA：通过掩码下一尺度表征预测实现统一多模态模型的生成式预训练
hf.summaryZh: 统一多模态模型中生成训练未必带来理解能力提升，原因可能在于生成目标所针对的表征与理解所依赖的感知表征不匹配。UMM-JEPA 将生成重构为对连续视觉理解表征的渐进预测：由粗到细构建多尺度表征层级，像素渲染与表征预训练解耦并仅在之后接上。受控对比显示，表征预测目标贡献了大部分理解增益，16 个视觉基准均值为 51.71（仅理解的 Qwen-VL 基线为 46.36），文本均值亦上升；相比离散视觉码与 latent flow 目标，感知表征预测带来更强且更一致的迁移。线性探针与视觉证据干预表明模型学到了更丰富的物体与空间结构，说明当生成直接监督理解所消费的感知表征时，生成可以反哺理解。
hf.reason: 统一多模态模型的生成式预训练机制，架构与训练方法有分量

hf.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
hf.abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is 5.85times on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13times on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.
hf.titleZh: LoopFill:面向循环 Transformer 的流水线式多 token 投机解码
hf.summaryZh: 循环 Transformer 靠重复复用同一批层提升参数效率，但自回归解码时每个 token 都需串行多轮前向，延迟居高不下。LoopFill 是一种免训练的投机解码算法，把多 token 后缀草稿与浅层循环预测并入同一棵草稿树，后缀查找可即时延长浅层预测，让多个未来 token 同时进入流水线;共享块在一次批内计算不同循环深度上的最高分候选，全深度验证保持与自回归解码一致的输出分布。在七个基准上，相对贪心自回归解码的平均加速为 Ouro-2.6B 上 5.85 倍、Huginn-3.5B 上 5.13 倍，分别比最强基线 LoopAhead 高出 40% 与 25%。
hf.reason: 循环 Transformer 上的免训练投机解码，推理加速显著，命中效率方向

hf.title: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
hf.abstract: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.
hf.titleZh: 不变式感知的harness强制执行：保护LLM Agent免受API静默失败
hf.summaryZh: LLM Agent调用API时默认信任返回结果，但API可能静默失败：忽略请求中的部分参数却仍返回HTTP 200和看似合理却错误的数值。SilentGuard把判断从模型移到负责执行工具调用的harness上，用任何正确API都必须满足的不变式检验每次返回，违反约束就不把该数值交给模型。15个公开研究API中有11个存在此类失败，计数最高被夸大691倍，现有检查清单与LLM judge方案仍有超过70%的答案错误；跨7个开源模型，目标故障上的错误答案从74.0%降至1.7%，且无故障任务没有损失，3个前沿模型上从70.2%降至0.5%，仅给警告仍有70.1%错误。
hf.reason: Agent工具调用可靠性，harness级不变式强制，结果扎实

arxiv.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
arxiv.abstract: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
arxiv.titleZh: 「Resolution 假说」:Agent 进化的关键在于识别改进
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 进化遵循 proposer 提出候选(prompt、skill、memory)、selection 择优的循环，但该方法在不同论文间互有胜负、在部分任务上无法自举。研究者将其归因于 Resolution 假说:瓶颈不在提不出更好的候选，而在噪声评估无法可靠识别改进。在 7 种进化方法、6 个模型、超 1000 万次 LLM 调用上验证:候选层面有益候选确实存在，但选择区分有益与有害候选的能力不优于随机，误差逐轮累积;方法层面几个百分点的排名差距小于同一方法两次独立运行的差异，已发表排名常依赖运气。据此呼吁从设计更强的候选生成系统，转向让真实改进可被检测、可累积。
arxiv.reason: Agent 自我进化的评估可靠性系统研究，直击自我改进方向核心

arxiv.title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Whether a foundation model succeeds as an autonomous agent depends as much on its runtime software as on its weights. This runtime, the agent harness, manages context and memory, steers multi-turn control, executes tool actions in sandboxes, and verifies work before stopping. Because models differ in how they use tools and how they fail, a static harness tuned for one model or task often stalls, wastes tokens, or regresses on another. This bottleneck has driven a shift from prompt tuning to self-improving agent harnesses: systems that inspect their own execution traces, separate runtime bugs from model limits, and rewrite their own code. We present a unifying architectural and design framework for self-improving agent harnesses. The framework pairs four editable runtime components (context and state, agent control, action interfaces, and verification and recovery) with a four-stage loop that diagnoses failures, proposes code patches, validates candidates, and deploys updates. Using this framework, we show how optimizers trace errors across long trajectories and discover reusable runtime mechanisms such as pre-stop verifiers, loop breakers, and persistent memory. We further show why full-harness rewrites overfit or break across modules, and how modular updates with validation gates generalize across models while bounding token cost. To keep self-modification safe, we establish practical defenses against recurring failure modes including prompt bloat, benchmark gaming, and evaluator tampering. Finally, experiments on SWE-bench Lite validate this framework, showing that gated modular evolution outperforms prompt reflection and full-harness rewrites across models and repositories at a fraction of the token cost.
arxiv.titleZh: 能自我改进的 Harness：自我改进型 Agent Harness 的统一框架
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 的运行时软件（harness）决定了基础模型能否胜任自主任务，但为某一模型或任务静态调优的 harness 换模型后常会停滞、浪费 token 甚至性能回退。论文提出统一的架构与设计框架：把运行时拆成上下文与状态、Agent 控制、动作接口、验证与恢复四个可编辑组件，配以「诊断失败—提出代码补丁—验证候选—部署更新」四阶段自改循环。在 SWE-bench Lite 上的实验表明，带验证门控的模块化演化优于 prompt 反思与整体 harness 重写，且 token 开销更低。该工作为 Agentic RL 与 harness／scaffold 自动化提供了系统性设计参考，并给出针对 prompt 膨胀、刷榜与评估器篡改的防护。
arxiv.reason: 自我改进 Agent harness 统一框架，直击 Agent 与 scaffold 方向

arxiv.title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
arxiv.abstract: Scaling has driven the success of large language models (LLM), with sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enabling greater parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation. At large scales, MoE models rely on expert parallelism to distribute experts across devices. Each MoE layer requires two synchronous collective communication steps during inference: dispatching hidden states to the activated experts and combining the resulting expert outputs. As compute throughput has outpaced interconnect bandwidth, these synchronous collectives have become a major bottleneck to MoE scaling and efficiency. We address this challenge with EchoMoE, a lightweight architecture modification that retrofits existing MoE models, requiring approximately 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining. Motivated by the observation that transformer blocks update the residual stream incrementally, we use a hidden state from an earlier layer as a reference and communicate only the compressed difference between it and the current state, rather than communicating each hidden state in full. EchoMoE periodically refreshes these reference states and transmits only the compressed differences synchronously, reducing the traffic on latency-critical paths without significant computational overhead. EchoMoE reduces inter-node communication volume by 58% and improves throughput by 22.6%, while preserving average performance within 3.8 percentage points across 18 benchmarks. EchoMoE further improves inference throughput by up to 2.38x over bandwidth-constrained Ethernet, paving the way for wide-area distributed inference. EchoMoE also tolerates quantization of the communicated representations without measurable quality loss. We release an efficient implementation for applying EchoMoE to pretrained MoE models, together with an inference integration for vLLM.
arxiv.titleZh: 传递变化:通过激活压缩实现高效专家并行
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 推理中专家并行的两次同步集合通信(dispatch/combine)在算力增速超过互联带宽后成为瓶颈。EchoMoE 利用残差流逐层增量更新的特性，以较早层的隐藏状态为参考，只同步传输压缩后的差分，并周期性刷新参考状态，从而在不显著增加计算的前提下削减延迟关键路径上的通信量。在现有 MoE 模型上仅需约 1/8500 全量预训练的 token 即可改造，节点间通信量降低 58%，吞吐提升 22.6%,18 个基准上平均性能损失在 3.8 个百分点以内;在带宽受限的以太网下吞吐最高提升 2.38 倍，且对通信表示量化不敏感，并已给出 vLLM 推理集成。
arxiv.reason: MoE 专家并行通信压缩，系统与效率方向扎实且有数据

arxiv.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
arxiv.abstract: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.
arxiv.titleZh: 在专家构建任务上做 RL 能给 Nemotron 3.5 Super 带来什么
arxiv.summaryZh: 在 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super（总参数 120B、激活 12B）上，逐一用五个专家构建的任务数据集做纯 RL 后训练（无监督阶段），每个数据集训练一个全新的 rank-32 LoRA 适配器，算法为 CISPO，训练框架为 Tinker。在十二个主要基准上，各适配器相对基座模型同任务、同 harness 的增益从 IFBench 的 +4.5 分到 GDP_pdf 的 +13.8 分（10.4%→24.2%）；SWE-bench Pro V2 从 86.9% 升至 92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 63.9% 升至 70.3%，MultiChallenge 从 58.3% 升至 66.6%，AutomationBench 从 14.8% 升至 27.5%，Chartography 从 39.4% 升至 50.6%。对失败案例的逐条比对显示，基座模型的失败集中在少数几种模式，而各适配器更常补上基座模型漏掉的环节：工具调用适配器先找数据和规则再行动，代码适配器自写测试与临时文件，约束适配器把前序轮次带入回答，图表适配器用代码测量标记，文档适配器直接读取表格。
arxiv.reason: 旗舰级模型纯 RL 后训练实证，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
arxiv.abstract: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.
arxiv.titleZh: 从 TeleChat 到 Xing4：在国产芯片与框架上推进前沿 Agentic 模型
arxiv.summaryZh: TeleChat 系列演进到 Xing 4，在昇腾算力与 MindSpore 框架上同步推进模型架构与训练基础设施。架构侧考察稀疏激活、注意力设计、深度宽度与投机解码的权衡；预训练侧以 HyperParallel 的拓扑感知混合分片、分布式优化器与长序列显存协同管理，在 8192 张昇腾 910C 上完成 285B 参数模型预训练。后训练发布统一智能体平台 TeleGym，把执行、评估与轨迹构建接入策略优化，以分离式异步执行、有界过采样和部分 rollout 适配异构任务时长并保持轨迹连续性。
arxiv.reason: 旗舰级技术报告，覆盖架构、预训练与 Agentic RL 全栈

arxiv.title: RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
arxiv.abstract: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. To this end, we construct RSI-Prime, a dataset for improving model-training capability, comprising 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories. To help LLMs learn to make high-quality experimental decisions from training practice, we perform fine-grained decision identification and quality annotation, then apply decision-level loss masking to exclude supervision on low-quality behavior. Experiments with GLM-5.3 on PostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training, show that training on RSI-Prime yields a 31.95% relative improvement in overall performance over the original GLM-5.3, highlighting a path toward future RSI systems in which models autonomously sustain their own advancement.
arxiv.titleZh: RSI-Prime：训练模型去训练模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 让 LLM 自主完成训练、改进目标模型，是递归自我改进(RSI)的基础能力，但模型自身的「训练能力」缺少系统研究。工作构建了 RSI-Prime 数据集，覆盖七类任务、350 条完整实验轨迹，对轨迹做细粒度决策识别与质量标注，并用决策级损失掩码屏蔽低质量行为的监督信号。在自主后训练基准 PostTrainBench 上，用该数据训练 GLM-5.3 使总体性能相对提升 31.95%，指向模型自主维持自身进步的 RSI 路径。
arxiv.reason: 自主后训练数据与决策级掩码，直击 RSI 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: CrossEnv: Synthesizing Verifiable Cross-Environment Tasks for Long-Horizon Agent Training
arxiv.abstract: Executable synthetic environments provide scalable training tasks and verifiable feedback for long-horizon agents. Existing environment synthesis methods primarily generate tasks within individual environments. However, these tasks do not adequately capture real-world interactions across services, where actions in one service depend on information obtained from another. Synthesizing such tasks is challenging because data generated across environments must remain consistent to support executable and verifiable interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce CrossEnv, a framework that uses an entity-tool graph to identify connections between environments and aligns task-specific data to synthesize executable, verifiable cross-environment tasks. We further propose CrossEnv-Curriculum, which progresses from single-environment tool use to coordination across more environments and business domains, before introducing user interaction. Across four external benchmarks, combining cross-environment training data with this curriculum achieves competitive performance with fewer training examples. Further analyses support the benefits of cross-environment data and curriculum training, and provide evidence of transfer to new environment combinations, external tasks less similar to the training data, and longer workflows.
arxiv.titleZh: CrossEnv：为长程 Agent 训练合成可验证的跨环境任务
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有可执行合成环境多在单一环境内生成任务，难以刻画真实世界中一个服务的动作依赖另一服务信息的跨服务交互，难点在于跨环境数据须保持一致才能支持可执行、可验证的交互。CrossEnv 用实体-工具图识别环境间的连接点，并对任务相关数据做对齐，从而合成可执行且可验证的跨环境任务；配套的 CrossEnv-Curriculum 从单环境工具使用逐步扩展到跨更多环境与业务域的协调，最后引入用户交互。在四个外部基准上，跨环境训练数据配合该课程只需更少训练样本即可达到有竞争力的表现，并显示出向新环境组合、与训练数据相似度较低的外部任务及更长工作流的迁移证据。
arxiv.reason: 跨环境可验证任务合成+课程训练，直接命中 Agentic RL 与环境合成

arxiv.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Parallel Looped Transformers (PLTs) use otherwise idle decoding compute by overlapping recurrent iterations. However, vanilla PLTs scale poorly with depth: they exhibit training-loss spikes, and their quality gains shrink as more loops are added. The benefit of additional loops depends on the information available to each iteration, so we examine whether the existing computational dependencies limit effective depth scaling. We find that only the preceding in-trajectory state is passed across loop boundaries, even though completed cross-trajectory representations are already available. Based on this finding, we propose InfuseLoop, a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism. It aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories through lightweight attention residuals. This design preserves token-parallel training and concurrent loop execution, and requires only $O(Rd)$ additional hidden-state storage. Experiments show that InfuseLoop eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops. At eight loops, InfuseLoop reduces perplexity by 3.4--17.1% relative to vanilla PLTs and by 10.5--37.3% relative to the non-looped baseline. It also improves average downstream accuracy by 0.84 and 1.99 percentage points over these two baselines. InfuseLoop incurs only 0.3% decoding time over vanilla PLTs and 23.3% over the non-looped baseline, while keeping the same logical KV-cache footprint as vanilla PLTs.
arxiv.titleZh: InfuseLoop：面向可扩展并行循环 Transformer 的跨轨迹隐状态注入
arxiv.summaryZh: 并行循环 Transformer（PLT）通过重叠循环迭代来利用闲置的解码算力，但随深度增加会出现训练损失尖峰、循环次数增多后质量收益递减。分析发现循环边界只传递同轨迹的前一状态，而跨轨迹已完成表示其实已经可用。据此提出 InfuseLoop，用轻量注意力残差把后续预测轨迹中因果可用的隐状态聚合进来，同时保留 token 并行训练与循环并发执行，额外隐状态存储仅 O(Rd)。实验显示其消除了损失尖峰，八个循环时相对 vanilla PLT 困惑度降低 3.4–17.1%、相对非循环基线降低 10.5–37.3%，下游平均准确率分别提升 0.84 与 1.99 个百分点，解码时间仅增加 0.3% 与 23.3%，逻辑 KV-cache 占用与 vanilla PLT 相同。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 架构改进，属架构与效率方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
arxiv.abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
arxiv.titleZh: Ambient LLMs：通过温度匹配实现数据高效的监督微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 后训练数据规模远小于预训练数据，SFT 容易过拟合并遗忘数据分布的尾部。Ambient SFT 让微调模型在粗粒度上去匹配一个冻结的预训练模型：要求后训练模型条件分布的高温版本与预训练模型的高温版本一致，温度 T 作为对预训练模型的信任度旋钮，T→∞ 退化为常规 SFT，T=1 即知识蒸馏。在域适应、指令微调和推理任务上均优于标准 SFT，平均相对提升最高达 21%。该框架把蒸馏与 SFT 统一到一个温度参数下，为小数据后训练提供了一条简单的抗遗忘正则化路径。
arxiv.reason: SFT 抗遗忘新正则，统一蒸馏与 SFT，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM Agent 还需要被告知如何自我改进吗？
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究一个自主范式：仅给定基本原语、资源与笼统的自我改进目标，让冻结的 LLM Agent 自行构造基于上下文的自我学习算法。以游戏为试验台，Agent 拥有计算预算和采集经验、更新文本文档的工具，在无外部循环、无法访问真实数据的情况下自由实验。能力足够的模型确实能自主改进，其策略与自我调节学习的经典认知框架及自生成课程文献中的构念相吻合；学到的文本产物还能迁移到不同游戏时长、机制与 3D 导航等外部基准上并带来提升。
arxiv.reason: 自主自我改进 Agent，属自进化与 Agent 方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
arxiv.abstract: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型预训练的结构—残差归纳偏置
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对下一词预测是否足以学习良好内部表征，提出结构—残差归纳偏置原则，将表征拆分为结构与实现细节。Boundary Bottleneck Concept（BBC）通过边界载体路由 token 片段信息并保留局部自回归计算；Continuous Concept（CC）正则化表征几何，诱导低频结构与高频残差的谱分解，并给出编码界。在 300M token 训练下，BBC 与 CC 组合使 GPT-2 Medium 的 NLL 降低 1.44%，增益延续到 20B token；诊断显示 BBC 提升边界状态的预测重要性、CC 降低谱残差能量。适合关注预训练架构与表征归纳偏置的研究者。
arxiv.reason: 预训练归纳偏置新方法，实验较扎实，直接命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
arxiv.abstract: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal. Nevertheless, existing HA-GRPO methods share a key issue: no hint is available at inference time to append to the question, creating a training-inference context mismatch that leads to inconsistent performance gains.
