In this work, we reinterpret the function of hinting -- not as reducing question difficulty, but as steering model behavior -- and propose ASH (Activation Steering for Hinting), a novel HA-GRPO method built on this view. During training, the model is presented with both hinted and plain questions, while a trainable steering vector is optimized to widen the margins between the model's generation probabilities for responses to the hinted version relative to the plain version, thereby capturing the question-agnostic component of the behavioral shift induced by the hint. During inference, the trained steering vector is directly injected into the model's activation, reproducing the hint-conditioned behavior without requiring any hint in the context. Experiments with four LLMs (Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base, Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct) show that ASH consistently improves pass@$k$ on competition-level mathematics benchmarks (AMC, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) and out-of-distribution benchmarks (Minerva, GPQA-Diamond). Notably, it improves average pass@8 of Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base by \textbf{2.60}\% and \textbf{2.21}\%.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过激活引导正确实现带提示增强的GRPO
arxiv.summaryZh: HA-GRPO在训练时向问题附加hint以获得可用的梯度信号，但推理时无hint可加，训练与推理的上下文不匹配，使性能增益不稳定。ASH把hinting重新解释为对模型行为的引导，而不是降低题目难度：训练时同时输入带hint的问题与纯问题，优化一个可训练的steering vector，拉大模型对带hint版本回答的生成概率相对于纯问题版本的margin，从而提取与具体问题无关的行为偏移；推理时直接将该向量注入模型激活，无需上下文中出现hint即可复现hint条件下的行为。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base与Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct上，ASH在AMC、OlympiadBench、AIME24/25及OOD的Minerva、GPQA-Diamond上一致提升pass@k，Qwen3-1.7B-Base与Qwen3-4B-Base的平均pass@8分别提升2.60%与2.21%。
arxiv.reason: 用激活引导消除HA-GRPO训练与推理不匹配，直接命中RLVR后训练方向

arxiv.title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 Agent 治理的多条自然语言准则的运行时验证
arxiv.summaryZh: AI agent 的输出常需同时满足上百条自然语言准则，现有验证器难以高效判定其中哪些被满足、违反或不适用。VFM 以树注意力编码共享上下文与目标文本，并行对 N 条准则给出独立的三元判决，并在由 39.4 万条（上下文、目标、准则、判决）元组构成的 CriteriaBank 上预训练。微调后的 VFM-4B 在合成治理基准上优于 GPT-5.4，在 DynaBench 上的 trace 级失败检测优于 DynaGuard-4B，逐准则判决还能定位被违反的规则并支持升级到更强的 CoT 裁判；单张 H100 上对 4K 上下文评测 1000 条准则耗时不足 2s、显存低于 11GB。
arxiv.reason: Agent 治理的运行时多准则验证器，含新架构与数据集

arxiv.title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
arxiv.abstract: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.
arxiv.titleZh: Gemma 4 的 K=V 缓存只存一份：在分页服务引擎中实现精确的全局 KV 显存节省，且不修改注意力核
arxiv.summaryZh: Gemma 4 全局注意力层中 value 是 key 的归一化投影、key 是 value 乘以固定权重，理论上只需存一行，但现有开源引擎仍完整存 key 与 value。该工作只存一条 640 值行，用两个重叠的跨步视图分别充当 key 缓存与 value 缓存，使未改动的 paged attention 核直接读取，实数运算下完全精确。vLLM 原型在 16-bit 31B 模型上与原始缓存的同算术模拟逐比特一致，32K–64K 上下文每请求稳态解码 KV 显存降为 1/1.34–1/1.40；双 A100 prefill/decode 分离且带 NIXL 传输与 CPU offload 时，15 GiB 全池解码引擎每步 token 数为原版 1.38 倍（16K prompt）与 1.24 倍（8K prompt），块池模型预测误差在 1% 内。代价是 eager 单步慢 4%–9%，默认规模下暂不能与 8-bit KV 缓存叠加。
arxiv.reason: KV cache 压缩落地 vLLM 服务引擎，命中系统与效率方向

arxiv.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
arxiv.abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.
arxiv.titleZh: TPHC：用张量并行分组更新改进超连接
arxiv.summaryZh: 超连接（HC）把 Transformer 的残差流扩展为 N 条并行流，mHC 用流形约束使其在大规模下稳定，但每个子层只向所有流写入同一份输出，导致流数超过 4 后收益甚微。TPHC 将张量并行（TP）分片与 HC 流结合：为每个 TP 分片单独路由一组残差流混合，写回时保各分片输出独立，使每条流收到不同混合，从而提升残差更新的表达力，且不增加注意力与前馈子层的参数与 FLOPs。8B 模型、四流设置下训练时间仅比 mHC 多 9%，流数从 4 增至 16 只多 19%；1.1B 模型训练 100B token 后验证损失降低 0.7–1.0%，六个常识推理基准零样本平均准确率提升 0.3–0.7 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: 残差流架构改进结合张量并行，训练开销低且有实证收益

arxiv.title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to softmax under a unified distillation protocol, and model scala alone does not close these gaps. We show this gap is not intrinsic to kernelization: LARA++, a principled extension of LARA that approximates softmax via importance sampling with adaptive proposal distributions, recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy. We establish that the gap is closable; however, the computational overhead remains substantial, leaving the efficiency wall intact. Code is available at https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026
arxiv.titleZh: 内核现实检验:大规模高效注意力的基准测试与蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 kernelized attention 声称以 O(N) 复杂度替代 softmax 注意力却缺乏系统性公平评测的问题，在统一蒸馏协议下跨模型规模对比了各类 kernelized 方法与现代基线。效率侧发现 FlashAttention 在多数序列长度下的训练显存与墙钟时间均优于 SOTA kernelized 方法(仅因果语言模型推理显存为例外)，且原论文报告的效率收益常无法复现;质量侧 kernelized 方法落后 softmax 2–10 分，扩大模型规模无法弥合。提出 LARA++(基于自适应提议分布重要性采样的 LARA 扩展)可恢复最高 99% 的 softmax 精度，但额外计算开销使效率墙依然存在。为线性注意力研究提供了可复现的评测基准与清晰的适用边界。
arxiv.reason: 高效注意力系统性评测加蒸馏新方法，命中架构与效率方向

arxiv.title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain these differences by measuring how often a rule fires, how often the patch changes afterwards, and whether those changes repair or break it. Fine-tuning agents to imitate the rule saves 30% over six seeds, while quality preservation remains uncertain. Our results help identify both the opportunities and the risks of early stopping.
arxiv.titleZh: 已完成但仍在工作：编码智能体何时应停止的任意时刻评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体常在自测通过后继续修改补丁，这种额外工作是否真的改善补丁、早停又能省下多少，此前缺少量化答案。工作提出 anytime evaluation：重放已记录轨迹，用隐藏测试给各中间补丁打分并计录每步成本，从而在无需新生成轨迹的前提下对「只做停止或选择早期补丁」的策略做配对比较。在 SWE-bench Verified 上覆盖 8 个开源模型、2 种 scaffold、约 6000 次运行，发现自测通过时的事后节省从不足 1% 到 57% 不等；同一补丁连续两次通过即停止的规则在预注册复现中省 23%，但质量非劣性检验未通过，而用微调让智能体模仿该规则在 6 个种子下令成本降低 30%，质量保持仍不确定。结果刻画了早停的收益空间与风险来源（规则触发频率、补丁后续改动比例及其修复或破坏方向），可用于编码智能体的成本控制与停止策略设计。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体早停的系统量化研究，SWE-bench大规模实证

arxiv.title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. We train the three components through diagnostic-guided co-evolution: alternating updates optimize them with a shared answering reward, while Retrieval Potential Feedback (RPF) and Latent Efficacy Feedback (LEF) identify questions that need better retrieval or latent guidance and direct targeted resampling. Across four benchmarks and seven evaluation settings, our framework obtains average scores of 69.9 and 75.0 with 7B and 8B Reasoner backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.0 and 9.1 points, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 协同证据检索与利用的自改进多模态科学文档推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态科学文档推理需要跨文本、图表整合证据；仅靠检索容易漏掉互补支撑，而只使用答案级反馈又无法区分错误源于「取不到证据」还是「用不好证据」。为此提出 Retriever–Perceiver–Reasoner 智能体框架：Retriever 在上下文预算下顺序选取与来源对齐的证据，Perceiver 依据问题构建问题条件化的隐式本体，把多模态证据组织到共享连续空间，Reasoner 结合隐式引导与原始来源生成有据可依的答案。三个组件通过诊断引导的协同进化训练，共享答案奖励交替更新，并用 Retrieval Potential Feedback 与 Latent Efficacy Feedback 定位需要改进检索或隐式引导的问题、定向重采样。在四个基准、七种评测设置下，7B 与 8B Reasoner 骨干分别取得 69.9 与 75.0 的平均分，超出最强基线 4.0 与 9.1 分。
arxiv.reason: 多模态科学文档的 Agentic 检索推理与自改进协同训练，命中 Agent 与 MLLM 方向

arxiv.title: EvoSkill-S1: Evolving Reusable Skills with Genetic-Inspired Operators
arxiv.abstract: Reusable skills allow language-model agents to accumulate and reuse problem-solving experience. However, most existing methods improve a skill bank only indirectly through rollout-driven accumulation and heuristic reflection, often resulting in shallow and weakly controlled updates. We present EvoSkill-S1, an RL-driven framework that instead treats reusable skills themselves as the direct objects of evolution. Given hard-negative failures, EvoSkill-S1 selects parent skills and transforms them into candidate child skills through five genetic-inspired operators: revision, cross-revision, mutation, dual-reflection, and crossover. Downstream task rewards train the skill evolver to generate more effective child skills, while evaluator-guided write-back selectively retains beneficial updates. Complementary Skill Bank Fusion consolidates operator-specific banks to exploit their distinct recovery patterns, while a Procedural Skill Interface supports transfer to unseen problems. Across all reported math and code benchmarks, EvoSkill-S1 improves the corresponding initialized skill banks under both Qwen and GPT-family solvers, with relative gains of up to 12.39%. Compared with the strongest external baseline without direct skill evolution, the largest relative improvement reaches 20.39%.
arxiv.titleZh: EvoSkill-S1：用遗传启发算子进化可复用技能
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有技能库多依赖 rollout 累积与启发式反思间接更新，技能更新浅且不可控；该工作把可复用技能本身当作进化对象：从硬负例失败出发，用改写、交叉改写、变异、双反思、交叉五种遗传启发算子将父技能变换为候选子技能，以下游任务奖励训练技能进化器，并由评估器引导回写、只保留有效更新；另外用技能库融合整合各算子专属技能库，用过程化技能接口迁移到未见问题。在 Qwen 与 GPT 系列求解器上，数学与代码基准的对应初始技能库相对提升最高 12.39%，相比不做直接技能进化的最强外部基线相对提升达 20.39%。
arxiv.reason: 技能库进化并由 RL 训练进化器，命中 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
arxiv.abstract: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.
arxiv.titleZh: PACT:通过保留正确计划与修复动作实现 GUI Agent 的计划-动作一致性训练
arxiv.summaryZh: GUI Agent 常在推理中给出正确的即时计划，却输出无法执行该计划的动作，形成「执行鸿沟」;在结果监督的强化学习中，把响应级负优势广播到全部 token 会连正确的规划一起惩罚。PACT 用标注的参考动作定位执行鸿沟，对已验证计划的 token 段屏蔽负的策略梯度贡献以保护计划，再保持生成的推理不变作为上下文，通过带 stop-gradient 成对权重的偏好替代目标，使参考动作优于错误动作，且不改变原有标量动作奖励。在 AndroidWorld 上任务成功率由 60.34% 提升到 68.97%(+8.63pp),AndroidControl High 上的规则化计划-动作一致性由 83.71% 提升到 89.74%;迁移到桌面端后，OSWorld 全部 369 个任务的成功率由 40.92% 提升到 44.17%。该工作为多步 GUI 任务中的细粒度信用分配提供了可复用方案。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 的信用分配改进，直击后训练方向且跨平台验证扎实

arxiv.title: When Agent Skills Go Stale: Runtime Behavior and Selective Maintenance in Evolving Environments
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills use past experience and current observations to guide decisions and actions on related tasks. This experience is retained in skill state, whose reuse can amortize inference-time reasoning and environment interaction. When environment changes, parts of this state can become outdated while others remain useful. Across four task settings and two models, we compare skill reuse before and after environment changes. Previously beneficial skills can reduce task performance by over 10 percentage points or increase execution cost by nearly 40% relative to no skill. Task success can also remain unchanged while execution savings decline. These effects depend on which environment-specific details become outdated and the agent's ability to compensate using current observations. We introduce selective maintenance, which replays checks from successful executions without additional model calls. It verifies whether observed differences conflict with skill state, repairs affected content, and validates updates, rebuilding when local repair is insufficient. No description of the change is supplied. Relative to reusing stale state, maintenance improves task accuracy by up to 67pp and reduces execution steps by up to 37%. These results suggest that preserving a skill's inference time value as environments evolve requires selectively maintaining its state.
arxiv.titleZh: 当 Agent Skill 过期时：演化环境中的运行时行为与选择性维护
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 复用历史经验形成的 skill state 可摊薄推理与环境交互开销，但环境变化会让其中部分内容失效。论文在四种任务设置、两个模型上对比环境变化前后的 skill 复用：原本有效的 skill 可使任务性能下降逾 10 个百分点，或使执行成本相对无 skill 上升近 40%，也可能成功率不变而执行节省消失。提出 selective maintenance，在不额外调用模型的情况下重放成功执行中的检查，判定观测差异是否与 skill state 冲突，修复受影响内容并验证更新，必要时整体重建。相较复用过期状态，该方法任务准确率最高提升 67pp、执行步数最多减少 37%。
arxiv.reason: Agent skill 复用与维护，属 Agent 记忆与 scaffold 方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: SciWorkBench: A Benchmark for Real Scientific Workflows
arxiv.abstract: Language models are increasingly being used as agents capable of planning and executing projects, as well as refining their actions through feedback. This shift raises a question: can current agents complete projects like real scientists? To examine this question, we introduce SciWorkBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' abilities on real science tasks across biology, chemistry, materials science, and physics. SciWorkBench is built from peer-reviewed literature or expert-contributed research scenarios. We also propose a unified scientific analysis framework validated by domain experts, which can categorize most tasks in SciWorkBench. Each task covers one or more stages of this framework. We evaluate up-to-date models within the Claude Code and Codex agent frameworks under a unified execution and grading protocol. The best-performing agent achieves a mean score of 57.38, indicating that current agents still struggle with realistic scientific workflows. Our failure analysis identifies three recurring weaknesses at the workflow level: difficulty translating scientific knowledge into task-specific procedures, weak integration of evidence across different modalities, and limited capacity for scientific self-correction. These findings highlight the importance of workflow-based evaluation for measuring progress toward reliable AI systems for scientific research.
arxiv.titleZh: SciWorkBench：面向真实科学工作流的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对当前 agent 能否像真实科学家一样完成项目这一问题，构建覆盖生物学、化学、材料科学与物理学的基准，任务取自同行评审文献或专家撰写的研究场景；同时提出经领域专家验证的统一科学分析框架，可将多数任务按阶段归类。在统一的执行与评分协议下，于 Claude Code 与 Codex 两类 agent 框架中评测最新模型，最佳 agent 平均分仅为 57.38。失败分析归纳出三类工作流层面的共性弱点：科学知识难以转化为任务特定流程、跨模态证据整合薄弱、科学自我纠错能力有限，说明基于工作流的评测对衡量科研 AI 进展是必要的。
arxiv.reason: 科研智能体基准，跨学科专家验证且失败分析扎实，命中 AI for Research 与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. The field is computed from internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, assigning larger update weight to positions that are both visually anchored and decision-bearing while remaining mean-one, so the total credit of each rollout is preserved and only its positionwise allocation changes. Gaze-RL requires no process supervision, auxiliary perception module, or architectural modification, and improves both Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 across a broad range of image and video benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 更新中的眼睛?学习奖励在多模态推理中的落点
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态后训练已从指令微调转向面向图像与视频推理的强化学习，但结果奖励只赋给整条生成轨迹，而视觉证据仅出现在回复中稀疏且不均匀的位置。Gaze-RL 从模型自身的内部跨模态几何与局部预测不确定性构造一个潜在「奖励落点场」，把 completion 级 advantage 重分配为位置级权重，权重均值为一，保持每条 rollout 的总信用不变、只改变其位置分配，因而无需过程监督、辅助感知模块或架构改动。在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 上，该方法在多种图像与视频 benchmark 上均取得提升。
arxiv.reason: 多模态 RL 的 token 级信用分配，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
arxiv.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. We derive a scaling law that unifiedly describes these dynamics, enabling accurate loss predictions across mixture ratios, training steps, and model sizes. Crucially, our law characterizes the trade-off between early and late fusion: under a fixed data budget, early fusion preserves text performance while late fusion favors vision performance, yielding a trade-off that increasingly tilts toward early fusion as model size scales. Extensive experiments confirm that our scaling law reliably captures multimodal learning dynamics and governs fusion decisions.
arxiv.titleZh: 视觉-语言融合的缩放定律
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对视觉-语言模型中早期融合与晚期融合的选择长期依赖昂贵启发式实验的问题，把多模态预训练的验证损失分解为「基础学习轨迹」（不同数据类型以不同速率贡献）与「模态竞争导致的分布偏移」两部分，并据此推导出统一缩放定律，可在混合比例、训练步数与模型规模上预测损失。实验表明，在固定数据预算下，早期融合能保住文本性能、晚期融合更利于视觉性能，且随模型规模增大，该权衡逐渐向早期融合倾斜。该结果为多模态预训练的数据配比与融合范式选择提供了可量化的决策依据。
arxiv.reason: VLM预训练缩放定律，早晚期融合权衡，命中架构与预训练方向

arxiv.title: BQ-LoRA: Binary-Quantized Low-Rank Adapters as Implicit Regularizers for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of quantized large language models is dominated by QLoRA, which combines 4-bit weight quantization with FP16 low-rank adapters. We ask whether the FP16 adapter precision is necessary. Replacing it with a single binary bit per adapter parameter, combined with a learned per-layer scale $s$ and a Scaled Straight-Through Estimator, reduces adapter storage by 13-16x. We introduce two variants -- NormScale, which binarizes under a norm-preserving scale with a clipped STE, and LearnThresh, which makes the binarization threshold learnable -- unified under a framework we call BQ-LoRA. Our main theoretical contribution is a tight characterization of the BQ-LoRA hypothesis class: it has bounded entrywise norm, a typical-set spectral norm bound that is $Θ(r)$ times sharper than the worst case, a full-rank, near-isotropic update, and consequently a Rademacher complexity that yields an explicit $\tilde{O}(s_{\max}α\sqrt{d_{out}/(rn)})$ generalization bound. FP16 LoRA has no comparable a priori norm or isotropy control. On Qwen2.5 (1.5B-72B), BQ-LoRA exceeds QLoRA's benchmark averages at every scale by 0.8-3.5 points; on LLaMA-2 (7B/70B) it remains competitive at the same storage reduction but does not uniformly lead the strongest FP16-adapter baselines (LoftQ at 7B, QLoRA at 70B). On Qwen2.5-7B the binary adapter preserves the 4-bit base WikiText-2 PPL within 0.06 (9.86 vs. 9.80) while QLoRA worsens it by 0.59. The reduction applies to inference-time adapter storage and serving; training memory matches QLoRA and step time rises by under 4%. We translate the storage saving into a deployment study, BQ-SGMV, by extending Punica's SGMV kernel with a binary inner-product primitive: the same A100-80GB holds 15.6x more adapters in HBM, and our research prototype eliminates cache misses under a skewed synthetic workload.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables
arxiv.titleZh: BQ-LoRA：二值量化低秩适配器作为参数高效微调的隐式正则化器
arxiv.summaryZh: 追问量化LLM微调中适配器是否必须保留FP16精度：把每个适配器参数量化为1 bit，配合可学习的逐层缩放与Scaled STE，存储降低13-16倍，并给出NormScale与可学习阈值的LearnThresh两个变体。理论上刻画该假设类：逐元素范数有界、典型集谱范数界比最坏情况紧Θ(r)倍、更新满秩且近各向同性，由此得到显式Rademacher复杂度与Õ(s_max α√(d_out/(rn)))泛化界。Qwen2.5（1.5B-72B）各规模均超QLoRA基准均值0.8-3.5分，7B上4-bit基座WikiText-2 PPL仅变0.06（QLoRA恶化0.59）；LLaMA-2上与最强基线持平。扩展Punica SGMV的二值内积原语后，A100-80GB可驻留15.6倍适配器。
arxiv.reason: LoRA量化与PEFT效率改进，含泛化理论与推理内核，命中后训练与系统效率

arxiv.title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) has powered landmark successes in reinforcement learning, yet its gains in LLM reasoning can remain modest despite substantial search effort. We identify an overlooked bottleneck: what MCTS counts. Standard UCT assigns independent visit counts to textual branches, allowing different formulations of the same reasoning strategy to repeatedly receive exploration bonuses. Our theoretical analysis shows that this count fragmentation can impair exploration efficiency, as quantified by increased cumulative regret. To address this problem, we introduce Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS (LPC-MCTS), which changes only the exploration statistic in UCT. A lightweight Coin-Flipping Network head on the policy's hidden representations estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence. Across 5 mathematical-reasoning and 7 search benchmarks, LPC-MCTS consistently outperforms strong MCTS baselines. Holding each LPC-MCTS-trained policy fixed, replacing standard MCTS counts at inference improves average mean@16 accuracy across 5 mathematical benchmarks by 3.79 percentage points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.71 points on Qwen3-4B. Applying LPC-MCTS during both training and inference yields gains of 4.96 and 4.37 points over standard MCTS, respectively. Together, our theory and experiments show that changing what MCTS counts can substantially improve its exploration efficiency and reasoning performance.
arxiv.titleZh: MCTS 数错了对象:为 LLM 推理学习探索计数
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 MCTS 在 LLM 推理上搜索开销大而收益有限的问题，指出瓶颈在于计数对象:标准 UCT 为文本分支分配独立访问计数，同一推理策略的不同表述会反复获得探索奖励，理论上导致计数碎片化并抬高累积遗憾。LPC-MCTS 只替换 UCT 的探索统计量，在策略隐表示上接一个轻量 Coin-Flipping Network 头估计表示覆盖度，使语义相关的分支共享探索证据。在 5 个数学推理与 7 个搜索基准上稳定优于强 MCTS 基线;固定策略仅替换推理计数，mean@16 平均提升 3.79(Qwen2.5-7B)与 2.71(Qwen3-4B)个百分点，训练与推理均启用则分别提升 4.96 与 4.37 个百分点。可直接用于 test-time 树搜索与带搜索的 RL 后训练。
arxiv.reason: 改进 MCTS 探索计数，命中推理时搜索与后训练方向，理论加实验扎实

arxiv.title: Context Has a Price: Adding and Removing Context for LLM Coding Agents under Prefix Caching
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents repeatedly send their conversation history to a language model. Adding useful code may reduce search, while removing old tool outputs may shorten later prompts. But do these changes reduce the cost of solving a task? We study this as a measurement problem in more than 20,000 runs of open models on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench and Loc-Bench. We account separately for uncached input, cached input and output tokens. Three findings emerge. First, in our main evidence-package experiments, retrieved code reduces read and search commands by 18--34%, but increases cost by 33--42% when cached input costs one tenth of uncached input, without a measurable improvement in resolution. Second, removing old observations can either save money or increase cost: the same approach saves 19--36% without a cache discount but increases cost by 38--116% with a tenth-price cache. Third, shorter prompts do not guarantee cheaper runs because agents may respond by taking more steps. We also find that concurrent experiments can share cached prefixes and distort cost comparisons. These results show why context-management methods should be evaluated using both token prices and the agent's subsequent behavior.
arxiv.titleZh: 上下文有代价：前缀缓存下为 LLM 编程智能体增删上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对编程智能体反复发送历史、增删上下文能否真正降本的问题，在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench 与 Loc-Bench 上对开源模型进行逾 2 万次运行，分别计量未缓存输入、缓存输入与输出 token 成本。检索代码使读取与搜索命令减少 18–34%，但在缓存价格为十分之一时成本上升 33–42%，解决率无显著提升；删除旧观察在无缓存折扣时省 19–36%，有折扣时反增 38–116%；更短提示还可能因步数增加而更贵，并发实验共享缓存前缀也会扭曲比较。结论是上下文管理需同时依据 token 价格与智能体后续行为评估。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体上下文成本测量扎实，命中 Agent 与缓存效率方向

arxiv.title: Sample-efficient Personalization of Large Language Model Alignment with Multidimensional User Preference Data
arxiv.abstract: Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. Although they are effective, these methods quantify uncertainty from the perspective of the LLM, which may differ from the uncertainty perceived by the user: a pair can appear highly uncertain to the LLM even when past comparisons from the user already imply a clear ordering. In this paper, we propose multidimensional preference-guided online direct preference optimization (MPG-DPO), which leverages low-cost multidimensional evaluations from automated verifiers on the user historical comparisons to construct a personalized preference cone guiding response selection for online preference alignment. Specifically, it first discards responses that are confidently dominated under the estimated user preference, then selects two responses that are competitive under the retained preference cone yet exhibit the strongest unresolved disagreement. Theoretical analysis shows that, with high probability, the fraction of queries spent on cone-dominated responses vanishes as learning progresses. Experiments across multiple LLM families show that MPG-DPO outperforms strong contenders under matched query budgets.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于多维用户偏好数据的大语言模型对齐的样本高效个性化
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线偏好对齐需要反复生成并标注新回复，标注成本高，样本效率因此成为核心瓶颈；现有方法多从模型自身不确定性出发挑选查询对，忽略了用户历史比较已隐含的明确排序。MPG-DPO利用自动验证器对用户历史比较做低成本多维评估，构建个性化偏好锥：先剔除在估计偏好下被明确支配的回复，再在剩余偏好锥内选取竞争性强且分歧最大的回复对进行查询。理论分析表明，随学习推进，耗费在被锥支配回复上的查询比例以高概率趋于零；在多个LLM系列上，相同查询预算下优于强基线。
arxiv.reason: 在线DPO样本效率与个性化对齐，含理论保证

arxiv.title: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
arxiv.abstract: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. To test the latter, we introduce five adversarial probes (Rule Application +-, Pattern Induction Style / Procedural, Dynamic Multiturn) judged at generation time by a cross vendor verification chain, where each query can only be solved by applying a remembered rule or pattern it never mentions. Across 5 probes x 20 scenarios, no architecture wins universally: atomic fact extractors (LangMem) win rule application, while BRIDGE's block-summary memory wins pattern induction. This result holds across four domains, three graders, and three reader families. Each design fails where the other wins, for reasons a recall benchmark cannot see: atomic-fact extractors discard the form a demonstrated pattern takes, while block-summary memory retrieves the rule but the reader does not act on it, a gap that presenting the rule more prominently largely closes. What separates memory designs is not what they retrieve but what they enable an agent to do, and that is what agentic memory should be evaluated on.
arxiv.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Main Conference
arxiv.titleZh: 披着风衣的RAG:最小记忆何时足够支撑Agent系统，何时不够
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向Agent记忆系统日益堆叠抽取、替代、反思与图合成等组件的现状，检验这些原语是否值得其开销。BRIDGE以链式观察笔记、BM25与余弦混合检索、按时间顺序渲染构成极简RAG记忆，每次摄入或查询仅一次LLM调用;在LongMemEval-S与BEAM上与先前SOTA在bootstrap置信区间内持平，在EverMemBench上同reader设置下领先最佳基线5.7–6.3分，每查询读者提示约5–7K token。进一步提出五个对抗性探针(Rule Application ±、Pattern Induction Style/Procedural、Dynamic Multiturn)，以跨厂商验证链在生成时评判，覆盖5探针×20场景、四个领域、三名评分者与三个reader家族:原子事实抽取(LangMem)在规则应用上胜出，块摘要记忆在模式归纳上胜出，没有架构全面占优。结论是记忆设计的差别不在检索到什么，而在使Agent能做什么，Agent记忆评测应据此重构。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆机制与评测方法学，直击Agent方向核心

arxiv.title: Readie: Low-Latency Code Sandboxes for AI Agents
arxiv.abstract: From quantitative research to personal assistance, AI agents act by iteratively generating and executing code. To decouple the agent harness from code execution, many agents offload execution to dedicated systems called code sandboxes. However, existing code sandboxes suffer from slow startup. Whether they rely on custom snapshots or a single fat image, the root cause is the same: it is hard to build a compact, pre-warmed snapshot that can be shared across diverse agent-generated code while covering nearly all the artifacts (e.g., packages, datasets) it requires. In this work, we propose learned startup snapshots for low-latency code sandboxes. Our insight is that while it is hard for a single snapshot to be both compact and cover most workloads, a set of snapshots can achieve both. Each snapshot is small, initializes quickly, and covers a fraction of agent-generated code; together, the set covers most of it. We learn this set from a large training workload by formulating snapshot construction as an optimization problem and solving it with an approximation algorithm. Planned on 15K public and LLM-synthesized scripts, our system, Readie, reduces startup latency by 3-22$\times$ and end-to-end runtime by 1.3-3.3$\times$ compared to existing approaches at the same storage budget.
arxiv.titleZh: Readie:面向 AI Agent 的低延迟代码沙箱
arxiv.summaryZh: AI Agent 通过反复生成并执行代码来完成任务，执行通常被卸载到独立沙箱，但现有沙箱启动慢:无论自定义快照还是单个大镜像，都难以构建既紧凑又能覆盖依赖包与数据集的共享预热快照。Readie 提出学习式启动快照，用一组小快照替代单一快照——每个快照体积小、启动快、只覆盖部分 Agent 生成代码，合起来覆盖绝大多数工作负载;并把快照集合的构建建模为优化问题，在大规模训练工作负载上用近似算法求解。在 1.5 万个公开与 LLM 合成脚本上，同等存储预算下启动延迟降低 3–22 倍，端到端运行时间降低 1.3–3.3 倍。该工作直接服务于 Agent harness 与 Agentic RL 环境这类需要低延迟代码执行的场景。
arxiv.reason: Agent 代码沙箱系统工作，低延迟基础设施，方法有拆解价值

arxiv.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
arxiv.abstract: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. At temperature 2, coding agents running top-p, top-k or Top-H resolve 0 of 100 GitHub issues, while the same agents running top-nsigma resolve 46 to 62 and win every issue the two samplers disagree on, on three Qwen3.5 models. Over all benchmarks top-nsigma keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%. Counting how many tokens each sampler lets through explains why. In one Llama-3.1-8B story, going from temperature 1 to 2 grows top-p's pool from 4 tokens to 51,845 while top-nsigma stays at 3. Across 133 combinations of sampler setting and temperature, the typical pool size predicts judged quality (Spearman correlation of -0.77), and when we pick the pool at temperature 1 and only apply temperature afterwards, Top-H, min-p and p-less stop collapsing. At the default temperature of 1 most samplers perform about the same, We release all code and data to the public.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
arxiv.titleZh: 长上下文生成是一个采样问题(当你把温度调高时)
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对开放权重模型生成越长越差、高温下尤其崩塌的问题，在29个1B–122B模型、十个基准及百万token检索任务上系统比较采样器，覆盖SWE类编码智能体、长思维链、长文写作与长上下文阅读。核心机制在于温度升高时候选token池是否保持小而稳定:温度2下top-p、top-k、Top-H在编码智能体上仅解决0/100个GitHub issue,top-nsigma解决46–62个，并在两者判断分歧的issue上全部胜出;跨基准top-nsigma中位保留温度1得分的100%,top-p仅26%。在133种采样器设置与温度组合中，典型池大小可预测评判质量(Spearman相关-0.77)，若在温度1下选定池再升温，Top-H、min-p与p-less不再崩塌。
arxiv.reason: 采样器与长生成稳定性，直击长思维链与Agent解码

arxiv.title: What MoE Routing Controls: Causal Interventions on Expert Trajectories
arxiv.abstract: In mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, a token is routed to a sequence of experts across layers. We investigate how forcing tokens onto chosen expert paths influences model behavior. We build a target path from the experts that a concept's or role's tokens most often use, and we add a fixed bias to each target expert's router logit during generation to steer the token toward this expert path. We study two kinds of targets. Format targets concern the form of the output, and concept targets concern its topic. In Qwen3-30B-A3B, we show that steering a format path changes the text the model writes. We also show that steering a concept path shifts the model's next-token probabilities toward the concept, even when the path is built in another language, yet this shift has little effect on the generated text. We investigate why formats reach the text but concepts do not by steering only part of the generation, and find evidence that a format, once started, reinforces itself. We show that the concepts religion and money steer most strongly, and that the effect is concentrated in the middle layers. We attempt to explain why the strength of the effect varies by concept through an analysis of embedding distinctiveness and word frequency.
arxiv.titleZh: MoE 路由控制了什么:对专家轨迹的因果干预
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 MoE 语言模型中 token 跨层依次路由到不同专家、但路由对模型行为的因果作用尚不明确的问题，该工作用概念或角色 token 最常经过的专家序列构造「目标路径」，并在生成时给路径上各专家的 router logit 加固定偏置以强制引导。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，格式路径的干预会直接改变输出文本的形态，概念路径的干预则把下一 token 概率推向该概念(即使路径由另一语言构造)，但对最终生成文本影响很小;只干预部分生成步骤的分析显示格式一旦启动会自我强化，且效应集中在中间层，不同概念强度差异可用嵌入区分度与词频部分解释。结果为 MoE 路由的可解释性与可控生成提供了因果层面的证据。
arxiv.reason: MoE 路由的因果干预分析，命中架构与可解释性方向

arxiv.title: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.
arxiv.titleZh: EvoDisco：面向演化式智能体记忆的策略发现
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM智能体的记忆演化与记忆内容同等重要，但现有方法的记忆变换算子与选择规则都是固定的。EvoDisco把记忆演化建模为进化式策略发现：可学习策略以当前记忆状态和近期任务历史为条件，从Abstract、Refine、Bridge、Reframe四种语义算子中选择并实例化，决定用哪个、何时用、如何用；策略由双层适应度驱动，内层按检索质量提升并以记忆复杂度正则打分，外层在决策窗口上结合算子效用遗憾、预测误差与选择多样性。在ALFWorld、WebShop和LifelongAgentBench的单遍在线加冻结迁移协议下，优于MemP、MemRL等基线，ALFWorld上分别领先8.8/12.9点与16.4/17.9点；消融显示两层适应度与算子库均有贡献。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆演化策略发现，双层适应度设计清晰，多个benchmark验证

arxiv.title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
arxiv.abstract: Professional work involves under-specified assignments, where relevant information is spread across workplace applications and may conflict or change over time. To evaluate how well frontier agents can perform economically valuable work in such settings, we introduce ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms. As in real banking workflows, agents must search email, chat, calendars, notes, and files to identify requirements, gather information, reconcile conflicts/updates, and then build complex financial models. Tasks were developed by experienced bankers based on their real deal work and take them 15-30 hours to complete. Agent deliverables are evaluated with expert-authored rubrics (median: 124.5 criteria) covering financial rationale and results, spreadsheet construction, completeness, and formatting. Despite completing substantial portions of the requested work, current agents rarely produce correct deliverables. Across today's frontier models, the best ones (Claude Opus and Fable) pass fewer than 11% of tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: ATLAS-Finance:在真实银行环境中评测 AI Agent
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向投资银行场景的端到端 Agent 评测基准，覆盖 13 家模拟公司的 100 个任务。Agent 需在邮件、聊天、日历、笔记与文件中检索需求、汇总信息、消解冲突与变更，再构建复杂财务模型;任务由资深银行家依真实交易设计，人工完成需 15–30 小时，并用专家撰写的评分量表(中位 124.5 条)从财务逻辑、表格构建、完整性与格式等维度评判交付物。当前前沿模型仅完成部分工作，最佳模型(Claude Opus 与 Fable)通过率不足 11%。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长程任务评测基准，贴合 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
arxiv.abstract: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. We evaluate reference recovery, offline execution with judged and native rewards, and online recommendation with real execution, building AgentSelect-Exec with 5,060 executed configurations. Our method recovers the complete reference configuration within ten candidates for 67.73% of AgentSelect queries, nearly twice the strongest baseline, and leads all baselines on SkillsBench. The proxy-trained critic raises the top-ranked agent's execution score from 7.58 to 8.37 out of 10; execution feedback increases it to 8.78, above the strongest baselines. Four target-domain queries suffice to adapt the generator to SkillsBench. Agents recommended online outperform the strongest baselines under both an LLM judge and native verifiers. These results support learning and transferring joint resource composition from task experience.
arxiv.titleZh: Agent 需要什么?Bundle 感知的 Agent 资源组合
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Agent 资源配置中骨干模型与工具-技能 bundle 的价值只有执行后才能确定这一问题，把任务条件下的资源组合形式化为联合选择骨干模型与工具 bundle 以最大化端到端执行效用。方法上先检索相似任务的候选资源与历史配置，用微调生成器读取资源描述并经约束 beam search 重组候选(新资源无需重训)，再由以 LLM 教师与历史成功配置为执行代理的 bundle 感知 critic 对完整配置排序，并可用执行反馈自适应。在 AgentSelect 上，67.73% 的查询可在前十个候选内恢复完整参考配置，约为最强基线两倍;critic 把 top-1 执行分从 7.58 提到 8.37(满分 10)，结合执行反馈达 8.78，四个目标域查询即可完成适配。
arxiv.reason: Agent 资源与骨干模型联合选型，属 Agent 系统方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
arxiv.abstract: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向推理时目标的分层策略学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理时扩展通常靠从单一策略重复采样来提升大模型表现，样本预算的分配方式本身较少被研究。该工作提出分层策略（stratified policies）：用共享语言模型骨干上的 k 个独立 LoRA 适配器构成策略群体，每个策略各贡献一条响应，共同服务一个 k 样本的推理时目标，并直接针对 pass@k 进行优化。理论分析在线性设定下表明，当每个 LoRA 的预测误差都严格为正时，策略群体仍可实现零 best-of-k 近似误差；在多个推理任务上，分层策略的 pass@k 稳定优于单策略基线。结果说明把采样预算分散到互补策略上，比在单一策略上做 i.i.d. 重复采样更高效，为推理时计算分配提供了新视角。
arxiv.reason: 推理时扩展与 LoRA 策略群体的结合，方法清晰，属后训练相关扎实工作

arxiv.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Basavarajearlybird/GIB-200K (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24320174)
arxiv.titleZh: 接地幻觉：视觉语言模型会像理想观察者那样权衡检索文本与图像吗？
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对检索增强VLM在文本有噪、图像退化两类证据都可能出错时的融合行为，构建GIB-200K（20万条基于COCO与Visual Genome的图像-问题样本），系统施加硬负例检索噪声、视觉模糊与跨模态反事实冲突；从理想贝叶斯线索组合推导可检验预测，定义Knowledge Inertia与Sensory Capture并用误差校正回归估计文本/图像权重。4个开源模型干净输入准确率为92.5%–94.2%，但对抗条件下跌至41.3%–59.9%，两个LLaVA模型过度依赖文本（w_T/w_I=1.229、1.322），InternVL3偏向图像（0.680），文档说谎时34.8%–71.4%的原本正确回答被放弃。
arxiv.reason: 多模态RAG证据权衡评测，方法学扎实，属评测方向

arxiv.title: Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Science advances from frontier to frontier as discoveries reshape what is known and create the basis for further discovery. We present Colombo, a self-organizing AI researcher that drives this renewal, first instantiated in oracle-based optimization. Here, the central question is how efficiently a problem class can be solved through a prescribed information interface and what costs no admissible algorithm can avoid. The gap between achievable guarantees and unavoidable limits defines the frontier recorded in its Complexity Atlas, a living map of frontier settings and the current state of knowledge. Self-Organization turns unresolved gaps into adaptive research programmes, coordinating conjecture formation, mathematical investigation, and replanning as evidence accumulates. Adversarial Co-Ascent develops algorithms and hard families through reciprocal challenge, exposing mechanisms of information use and concealment that guide stronger methods and proofs of unavoidable costs. Independent review and Lean-based formal certification check mathematical claims, while the Long-Term Memory carries supported findings and research experience across settings. To date, Colombo has established optimal or near-optimal rates for more than fifty settings in the Atlas. Colombo thus takes a concrete step toward Autopoietic Science: a scientific process whose validated advances regenerate the conditions of its own progress, continually reshaping how inquiry is organized and what it can discover.
arxiv.titleZh: Colombo:一个面向 Oracle 优化的前沿到前沿自动科研系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 oracle 优化中「可达保证与不可避免下界之间的差距」这一核心问题，构建了自组织 AI 科研系统 Colombo:以 Complexity Atlas 记录各问题类的前沿状态，用 Self-Organization 把未解决的 gap 转化为自适应研究计划，用 Adversarial Co-Ascent 让算法与困难实例族互相挑战，并通过独立评审与 Lean 形式化认证校验数学结论，长期记忆跨问题类沉淀经验。系统目前已在 Atlas 中为五十余个设定建立了最优或近最优速率，是向「自生成科学」迈出的具体一步。适用于自动数学发现与科研智能体方向。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 科研智能体，含形式化验证与自组织机制

arxiv.title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
arxiv.abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.
arxiv.titleZh: 价值观塑造自我改进编码智能体所构建的内容
arxiv.summaryZh: 自我改进智能体通常只以产出结果作为优化目标，很少关注它如何产出；而在开放式任务中，设计者通过指令塑造智能体工作方式的手段十分有限。这项工作在智能体持久指令文件中写入一段简短的价值观陈述，基于 Schwartz 基本人类价值观理论评估开放变革、保守、自我增强、自我超越四类高阶价值观，并在多轮自我迭代中保持固定，覆盖多种编码任务。结果显示：开放变革类价值观提升了智能体在留出数据上的表现，而相反的保守类价值观得分甚至低于不给任何价值观的对照；价值观还会改变产出的方案算法，使其在规模、复杂度与思路上出现差异；若允许智能体自行改写价值观，各价值观之间的差异会收窄，而从 AI 文献中提炼的价值观相对无价值观没有可检测的增益，说明价值观设计仍需人类把关。
arxiv.reason: 自进化编码智能体的指令层干预，命中 Agent 与代码方向，属实证研究

arxiv.title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
arxiv.abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
arxiv.titleZh: ForecastGym：一个面向预测智能体的实时、可控、可回放基准
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM预测型agent的评测受制于证据不可控：实时搜索把检索与推理混在一起，回溯搜索又会通过日期过滤或当前页面排序泄漏后续信息。ForecastGym每两天记录四个商业搜索API对开放预测市场问题的返回，首版含150个问题、614个证据状态、13.1万条搜索结果，揭晓后离线回放冻结证据，在固定获取策略下比较模型、记忆与搜索源。结算后重跑相同查询，最高92%的问题可近乎直接读出答案；冻结证据上所有被测LLM准确率均落后市场，换搜索API使Brier分数最多变化0.043、超过模型间差异，持久笔记与重读全部证据效果相当而输入token减半。
arxiv.reason: Agent评测基准，证据冻结可回放，直击Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
arxiv.abstract: Quantum chemistry relies on general-purpose software, whose generality leaves many large-scale calculations beyond practical resource budgets. Coding agents make task-specific programs cheap to write, but not efficient ones easy to find: whether a computational strategy is accurate and fast enough becomes clear only after it actually runs at the target scale. We introduce BORN, a foresighted agentic computing framework that synthesizes high performance quantum chemistry programs on demand. BORN anticipates the behavior of each strategy before execution, extrapolating its error from representative small systems and predicting its runtime from the target-scale workload and measured hardware throughputs. Building on these predictions, BORN unfolds the preset schemes of existing packages into independently configurable algorithmic components, selects the fastest strategy within the error tolerance from the predicted accuracy-runtime Pareto frontier, and guides coding agents to compile it with component-level performance predictions. For a Hartree-Fock calculation with 50,024 basis functions, BORN finishes in 1.41h on a single CPU node, 77$\times$ faster than the estimated runtime of a general-purpose baseline and still 9.8$\times$ faster with development time included. On a single GPU, BORN completes the ubiquitin calculation in 2.1,h, the same order of runtime as the GPU-accelerated package Mako on 64 GPUs, and shortens the B-DNA duplex calculation from an estimated two months to 8.1,h (173$\times$).
arxiv.titleZh: 为任务而生:用有前瞻性的 Agentic 计算重新思考量子化学
arxiv.summaryZh: 量子化学依赖通用软件，其通用性使大规模计算常超出实用资源预算;编码 Agent 能廉价地写出专用程序，却难以直接找到足够快且准确的策略。BORN 在执行前预判各策略的行为:从代表性小体系外推误差，依据目标规模负载与实测硬件吞吐预测运行时间;随后把现有软件包的预设方案拆解为可独立配置的算法组件，在误差容限内按预测的精度—耗时 Pareto 前沿挑选最快策略，并以组件级性能预测引导编码 Agent 完成实现。5 万基函数 Hartree-Fock 计算在单 CPU 节点上 1.41 小时完成，比通用基线估计快 77 倍，计入开发时间仍快 9.8 倍;单 GPU 上 2.1 小时完成泛素计算，与 64 GPU 的 Mako 同量级，并把 B-DNA 双链计算从估计两个月缩短到 8.1 小时(173 倍)。
arxiv.reason: Agent 按需合成科学计算程序，执行前预测精度与耗时，命中 AI for Research

arxiv.title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.
arxiv.comment: 12 pages; supplementary material included as ancillary files
arxiv.titleZh: 通过检查不等于完成任务:编码智能体中的证据解释
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体的验证流程需保留执行事实、界定其适用范围并履行检查义务。工作通过限定范围的仓库检查、受控证据消费者与可执行工作流展开:预注册的十三任务析因研究显示，报告事实正确未必给出所要求的有限结论;留出凭证供给研究中 122 个交付标签全部正确，却有 16 个回答误报事实、11 个越权。31 个任务、118 次修复回合表明，源码干预可将启动可达性与修复、证据生成与所声称操作分离。结果刻画了证据解释与适用性边界，并限制通用诊断优势一类主张。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体的验证与证据解释，切中Agent可靠性方向

arxiv.title: Remembered as Brief: Stored Preferences SilentlyRemove Decision-Critical Information
arxiv.abstract: People increasingly learn what they need for decisions about health, money, law and safety from AI assistants, and what an assistant leaves out the user never sees. An answer with a warning removed can be true in every sentence, so fact-checks pass it, and an assistant with memory applies a preference stored once to later questions the user never had in mind. We introduce \bench{}, an Inspect benchmark of 100 everyday decisions across 25 domains in which only the assistant's memory of the user varies: the user states a belief, the model infers it from a remark, or a web page the user asked to summarise plants it. Testing five models, we find three effects. First, after summarising a page with one line addressed to AI assistants, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and DeepSeek V4 Pro save ``prefers very short answers and does not want warnings'' as the user's preference in every episode, and 93\% and 84\% of their later answers miss a critical item, almost always silently; under a stated brevity preference, 78--96\% of omissions are silent. Second, the same two models then pick an option for the user on 80\% and 95\% of value-dependent choices, against none with neutral memory. Third, a one-line instruction leaves 2--8\% of answers with a silent gap but most missing content still missing, while listing the must-know points before applying the user profile restores more of the content in four of five models. We release the scenarios, harness and logs.
arxiv.titleZh: 被记为「简短」：存储的偏好会静默移除决策关键信息
arxiv.summaryZh: AI 助手一旦把用户偏好存入记忆，后续回答可能在句句属实的表面下悄悄丢掉决策关键信息，并替用户做出价值相关选择。为此构建 bench 基准，覆盖 25 个领域的 100 个日常决策，仅改变助手对用户记忆的来源(用户明说、模型从话语推断、由网页摘要植入)。测试 5 个模型发现:网页中一行写给 AI 的指令即让 Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在每一集都把「偏好极短回答、不要警告」存为用户偏好，后续回答分别有 93% 与 84% 遗漏关键项且几乎全是静默遗漏(明示简短偏好下 78–96% 的遗漏是静默的);这两个模型在 80% 与 95% 的价值相关选择上直接替用户选定，而中性记忆时为 0;在应用用户画像前列出必知要点，可在 5 个模型中 4 个恢复更多内容。该工作揭示记忆机制与简洁偏好叠加带来的信息可靠性风险，适用于助手记忆设计与安全评测。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆引发的静默信息丢失，基准与缓解实验扎实，命中记忆与评测方向

arxiv.title: Streaming On-Policy Distillation: Decoupling Three Clocks for Stage-Wise Supervision Consumption
arxiv.abstract: In on-policy distillation (OPD), response completion, supervision delivery, and parameter updates need not share the same granularity. We develop streaming OPD by decoupling these three clocks: a response repeatedly delivers newly generated segments while generation continues, retaining the full causal prefix at each delivery and computing loss only on new positions. A consumption protocol then organizes supervision budgets, position selection, staleness handling, and update scheduling, allowing control over quantity, coverage, and version lag across training stages. In GSM8K experiments distilling Qwen3-4B into Qwen3-0.6B with VERL, supervised-budget matching reduces the early gap between best test accuracies over seven common candidates from 4.55 to 2.42 points. Synchronous continuation from the same checkpoint reaches 73.39% best test accuracy over seven common candidates at u=384,...,576, versus 74.30% synchronous and 71.95% budget-matched (differences -0.91 and -2.35 points); an unpaired extended record reaches 76.12%. Freshness filtering and disagreement-overlap selection improve local peaks but do not establish sustained advantages. A system prototype shows lower data-supply waiting times without establishing an equal-update speedup. Quality recovery and supply-side benefits are assessed separately; end-to-end gains must account for continuation cost.
arxiv.titleZh: 流式在线策略蒸馏：解耦三个时钟以实现分阶段监督消费
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线策略蒸馏中，响应生成、监督交付与参数更新可按不同粒度解耦。流式OPD让响应边生成边交付新片段，保留完整因果前缀并只在新位置计损，再由消费协议管理监督预算、位置选择、陈旧度与更新调度。GSM8K上把Qwen3-4B蒸馏到Qwen3-0.6B，预算匹配将早期最佳准确率差距从4.55降到2.42分，同步续训为73.39%，介于同步的74.30%与预算匹配的71.95%之间。新鲜度过滤与分歧选择仅提升局部峰值，原型降低数据等待但未证实等更新加速。
arxiv.reason: 在线策略蒸馏的流式监督调度，直接命中后训练方向，但增益有限

arxiv.title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deployment-GPU calibration. The predictor is parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data, while adapting a frozen Qwen3-4B using LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer. Across NVIDIA RTX~5090, H100, L40 and AMD MI300X GPUs, SpecSearch with full calibration achieves an average of $2.01\times$ the throughput of AR and $1.36\times$ the throughput of SD, both served by vLLM. The proposed Jev-based predictor closely matches this search performance with $1.30\times$ throughput improvement over SD with vLLM, while eliminating the need for held-out GPU calibration. Additionally, it retains $97.36\%$ of the throughput achieved by SpecSearch that utilizes full calibration.
arxiv.titleZh: SpecSearch:迈向硬件感知的高效投机解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 投机解码的最优配置同时取决于负载特征、GPU硬件与可用显存:DFlash在RTX 5090低并发下吞吐达自回归3.50倍，高并发短输出时仅0.76倍。SpecSearch用解析代价模型刻画内存与算力约束，剔除不可行配置并缩小搜索空间，再基于多GPU标定数据训练以Qwen3-4B为底座(LoRA加线性修正层)的预测器，为未见GPU选择解码策略、草稿长度与精度。在RTX 5090、H100、L40与MI300X上，完整标定版吞吐为自回归2.01倍、vLLM投机解码1.36倍;预测器版达1.30倍且无需目标GPU标定，保留97.36%的搜索收益。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码配置搜索，系统性强，直击推理效率方向

arxiv.title: OfficePrism: Benchmarking Agents on Single-Domain Operations Across Enterprise Business Functions
arxiv.abstract: Broad workplace scores can mix competence within one business function with the extra cost of coordinating across functions and systems, making failures hard to localize. OfficePrism evaluates this prerequisite through 420 single-domain enterprise tasks spanning seven business functions under shared, benchmark-defined L1--L3 task-structure levels. Each task runs in a fresh environment combining a shared synthetic organization with one function-specific domain and yped state access. Our pipeline uses grounded records, business rules, and tool schemas to jointly construct a Chinese-language ticket, a hidden executable reference witness, and an expected response, followed by automated filtering and human curation. The same task set is evaluated through full-schema and search-and-dispatch packages. Across 124 model--harness--package configurations, the per-case joint natural-language-and-database pass rate ranges from 22.6% to 76.4%, with a median of 67.9%. L1 is highest in all 124 configurations, and L2 exceeds L3 in 122. Among 50 configurations sharing the same harness and model labels across both packages, search scores higher in 30, ties in one, and scores lower in 19.
arxiv.titleZh: OfficePrism：面向企业各业务职能单域操作的 Agent 基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对跨职能、跨系统的综合办公分数难以定位失败原因的问题，构建了含 420 个单域企业任务的基准，覆盖七个业务职能，并在共享的 L1–L3 任务结构层级下统一组织。每个任务在全新环境中运行，环境由共享合成组织、单一职能专属域与类型化状态访问组成；流水线结合落地业务记录、业务规则与工具 schema，联合生成中文工单、隐藏的可执行参考见证与期望回复，并经过自动过滤与人工筛选。同一任务集还以全 schema 与搜索分派两种封装形式评测。124 组模型—harness—封装配置的联合自然语言与数据库通过率在 22.6%–76.4% 之间，中位数 67.9%；L1 在全部 124 组中最高，L2 在 122 组中优于 L3，相同 harness 与模型标签的 50 组配置中搜索封装有 30 组得分更高。
arxiv.reason: Agent 企业任务基准，含 harness 对比与细粒度分层评测，契合 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 多智能体记忆不一致:事实冲突在 LLM Agent 中何处消失
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体委派让 worker 在各自独立上下文中收集证据，但 worker 检索到的事实可能在 lead 汇总结论时缺失，形成记忆不一致。作者在 Harvey LAB 文档审阅任务上构造受控事实冲突，发布基准与证据流分析工具，对比单智能体执行与强制委派。三个模型汇总显示:委派把冲突主张的检索率从 50.2% 提升到 68.7%，检出率却从 16.2% 降到 13.2%;worker 仅对 35.2% 的已检索冲突对同时上报两条主张，冲突被拆到不同 worker 时检出率低于同一 worker 读全两条。结果表明 worker→lead 的交接环节是多智能体冲突检测的主要瓶颈。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体记忆与证据流分析，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
arxiv.abstract: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $Θ(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points. In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points. Such overstatement is large enough to make the apparent winner statistically fragile. Thus, we use the same bootstrap to further quantify the intervals of plausible rank positions for each model and group models into tiers. We establish sufficient conditions for consistent recovery of population tiers. On SWE-bench Verified, this procedure places 13 of 173 models in the leading tier. We combine the score adjustment and rank intervals in the Rank Uncertainty and Leaderboard Evaluation Report (RULER). We validate its finite-sample performance using sample splitting and calibrated simulations, and advocate publishing RULER alongside raw rankings so readers can assess both reported performance and the precision of the ordering. RULER also provides guidance for benchmark design that accounts for selection effects and ranking uncertainty.
arxiv.titleZh: SOTA还是运气？LLM排行榜中的「赢家诅咒」
arxiv.summaryZh: 指出公开排行榜会系统性高估头部模型的分数：在带噪声的 benchmark 上按分数排序，等于把采样运气一并算进能力，且这种选择效应会通过「排名诱导偏差」扭曲整个榜单。提出 m-out-of-N bootstrap 校正方法，在模型池固定、任务独立同分布且有界的假设下（允许模型间存在任意任务内相关），证明可把 Θ(N^{-1/2}) 的排名偏差压到 o(N^{-1/2}) 的期望残余偏差。在 5 个 benchmark 家族的 14 个榜单上，rank-1 的校正幅度约为 0.09 至 3.86 个百分点，SWE-bench Verified 快照中并列第一需下调 0.90 个百分点，173 个模型里仅 13 个进入领先档。作者将分数校正与排名区间整合为 RULER 报告，建议与原始排名同时发布，以呈现排序精度并指导考虑选择效应的 benchmark 设计。
arxiv.reason: 排行榜统计偏差校正，命中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.
arxiv.titleZh: RegimeCouncil：面向LLM Agent记忆冲突治理的配对证据路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 长期记忆中的事实会随世界变化而过时，负反馈往往在依据过时记录行动之后才延迟返回：在记忆库更新前，这种负反馈应只抑制同一事实（局部），还是扩展到其他事实（全局），现有系统在设计时就已固定其中一种。RegimeCouncil用轻量配对证据路由器同时保留两种范围：Local Advisor只看被查询事实的最近结果，Global Advisor汇总所有事实的近期结果，Meta Governor默认跟随Local以避免跨事实干扰，仅在全局近期效用边际严格为正时切换，并保证延迟反馈下有限时间切换。在Qwen3-30B-A3B与GPT-4o的LongMemEval更新流及TempLAMA、TAQA历史漂移上，主分歧片段准确率比更优固定范围策略高5.2–7.3分，30个留出设置全部占优，消融任一模块下降2–7分。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆冲突治理，机制清晰且有理论保证，方向扎实

arxiv.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
arxiv.abstract: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.
arxiv.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Work in progress: benchmark design and protocol; results to be added in a later version
arxiv.titleZh: SkillBuffBench：衡量 Agent Skills 在不同 Harness、模型、Skill 访问模式与记忆条件下的贡献
arxiv.summaryZh: 关于 Agent Skills 的收益证据，大多来自“人工挑好 Skill、Agent 从空白起点开始”的理想设定，而部署时 Agent 要从已安装的 Skill 库中自行选择，并常携带先前工作的记忆。为此构建 SkillBuffBench 基准与配对评测协议：把 Skill 访问作为三水平因子（无 Skill、精选 Skill、从已安装库自动调用），与记忆开关、四种 Agent harness 以及多款模型（Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 的前沿闭源模型与国内开源权重模型）交叉，每个模型都在每种 harness 下运行；任务由材料科学与生物学领域专家提供并附带其使用的 Skill，用确定性 verifier 判分，以任务级配对 bootstrap 报告不确定性，成本、Agent 轮数与 wall-clock 时间与分数并列呈现，不合并计入。本版本仅给出基准设计、评测协议与当前任务与 Skill，评测仍在进行，结果待后续版本补充。
arxiv.reason: Agent Skills 评测基准，交叉 harness 与记忆，方向契合但结果未出

embodied.title: InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory.
